description:
Overview:

The BISO Infosec Lead for Supply chain and Commercial and Consumer Function will serve as the primary Information Security (Infosec) Lead for PepsiCo’s Supply Chain (Africa, Middle East, South Asia, International Beverage) and Consumer \& Commercial (EMEA) functions. Provide trusted, business\-aligned security advisory and execution across the region to manage cyber risk, enable secure solution delivery (projects, IoT/Beyond‑the‑Bottle, blockchain), drive vulnerability and third‑party risk remediation, and embed security into processes and product lifecycles to protect data, operations, brand and stakeholder trust.
Responsibilities:

Individual Responsibilities* Lead security intake for Supply Chain \& Consumer/Commercial workstreams in scope; ensure timely assessment, prioritization and routing of information security requests and issues.
* Act as the regional escalation point to the Sector BISO and Global Information Security for gaps, risk exposures and remediation plans; track closure and report status.

Provide security advisory across project lifecycles (planning deployment* operations), including ISA onboarding, secure design reviews and security requirement definition.
* Drive vulnerability management and remediation coordination with owners and Deployment Leads; validate mitigations and report risk reduction.
* Support Application Risk Assessments, legacy remediation and DevSecOps coaching for Supply Chain engineering teams.
* Manage third party security interactions: assessments, remediation tracking and collaboration with TPRM and blockchain provenance teams.
* Support Incident Response and Enterprise Incident Management locally; coordinate stakeholders, containment and post incident remediation.
* Own stakeholder engagement and awareness: design and deliver security content, training, and governance briefings to gain business buy in.
* Contribute to M\&A/JV due diligence and onboarding for security posture, particularly for bottlers, suppliers and technology integrations.
* Ensure security considerations for data residency/GCC processing and Beyond the Bottle device lifecycles are considered.


Role activity balance (approximate)* Operational \& Executional: 50% (work intake, remediation coordination, incident support, TPRM execution)
* Tactical: 35% (project advisory, stakeholder engagement, process improvements, training)
* Strategic: 15% (policy alignment, capability uplift, regional security roadmaps and M\&A enablement)


Decision making autonomy* Medium: empowered to make technical and process decisions within agreed policy limits escalating higher risk or policy exceptions to Sector BISO.


Supervision required* Low to Medium: operates independently day to day; receives directional guidance and policy/strategy from Sector BISO and Global Security leads.


Role complexity* High: cross domain technical breadth (application security , infrastructure security, IoT, blockchain, cloud, identity), regulatory complexity (cross border data, GCCs), multi jurisdiction stakeholder landscape, and process\+system risk focus.


Cross functional interactions* High: frequent collaboration with Supply Chain ops, Deployment Leads, Data Science/Analytics, IT/Cloud, Legal \& Privacy, Procurement/TPRM, Compliance, HR (insider/process controls), Finance (CAPEX/Project funding), Commercial and Marketing for product/program enablement.


Success measures / KPIs (examples)* % remediation actions closed within SLA; reduction in open critical vulnerabilities across scope; % key partners with acceptable security posture; reduction in risk in new engagements and secure from Start


Shared Accountabilities
Co‑manage security intake and prioritization with Deployment Leads and Project Managers (shared ownership for timely delivery of secure solutions).
Collaborate with Sector BISO on regional risk escalations, exception decisions and remediation prioritization (shared accountability for risk acceptance/mitigation).
Jointly own third‑party remediation and contract security requirements with TPRM and Procurement (shared execution and follow‑up).
Support Incident Response with Global IR while local Ops and business leaders share containment, communications and remediation responsibilities (shared incident management).
Partner with Data \& Analytics leads on AI/model governance and with Legal/Privacy on cross‑border data transfer decisions (shared governance and control implementation).
Coordinate with Security Architecture and Solutions teams for design approvals and with Finance for project CAPEX/security funding estimates (shared planning and funding accountability).
Qualifications:

Yrs of Experience
9\-12 years as BISO/IT Security Architect/Engineer or similar experience  

Mandatory Technical Skills* Experience with security architecture, application risk analysis,vulnerability management, data classification, CIS Top 20Critical Controls
* CISM, CISSP, GIAC certifications preferred
* Well versed in NIST Cybersecurity Framework
* Well versed in Agile development methodology andDevSecOps framework

  

Mandatory Non\-Technical Skills* Bachelor’s degree required
* Written/spoken English proficiency required
* Strong interpersonal and oral communication skills
* Ability to translate highly technical information into plainlanguage
* High level of analytical and problem\-solving abilities

  

Differentiating Competencies* Highly self\-motivated and directed.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Experience working in a team\-oriented, collaborative environment.
* Willing "can do" attitude
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work across multiple organizations and teams

title: HR Operations Lead
description:
**Founded in London, in 2010, Glassworks is a fresh London fashion brand – totally independent, style\-obsessed and passionate believers in bricks\-and\-mortar boutiques as well as streamlined digital shopping. Our design\-led stores and website are refreshed weekly with small runs of completely new fashion – meaning a constant feed of exciting new stuff to try on, helped along by the most dedicated and on it staff\-turned\-stylists on the planet. We are focused on scaling our ecommerce and retail channels in the UK and abroad – all whilst maintaining a strong design aesthetic, stylish atmosphere in store and strong customer focus.**

  



**The Role**


**We are looking for a hands\-on HR Operations Lead to bring structure, consistency, and process discipline to a growing business. Glassworks is scaling, but many HR and operational processes are still ad hoc and dependent on individual managers. This role is about building clear, repeatable systems that improve execution across the business.**


**This is a practical, build\-and\-improve role \- not purely strategic and not purely administrative. You will own recruitment operations, onboarding/offboarding, SOPs and training materials, KPI reporting, and day\-to\-day people operations improvement, working closely with leadership, managers, and external HR support.**

  



**Work Schedule/Location: 5 days per week, fully remote work.**

  



**What You Will Own**


* **Build and improve core HR and people processes (onboarding, offboarding, documentation, workflows)**
* **Own end\-to\-end recruitment operations, including pipeline management and candidate experience**
* **Own and improve our ATS (ClearCompany), including structure, workflows, reporting, and use of automation/AI**
* **Evaluate and recommend improvements to tools and systems as we scale**
* **Build and maintain SOPs and training materials in Notion (knowledge base), covering both HR and cross\-functional operational processes**
* **Work with the Senior Operations Manager and department leads to capture, standardise, and improve processes across the business**
* **Ensure SOPs are clear, practical, and consistently used by managers and teams**
* **Track and report on key HR and recruitment metrics (e.g. hiring pipeline, onboarding, training completion)**
* **Ensure employee records are accurate, secure, and audit\-ready in ADP (system of record)**
* **Maintain strong compliance discipline, working with our external HR partner where needed**
* **Identify gaps, prioritise improvements, and implement practical solutions that save time and reduce errors**

**What success looks like**


**In the first 3–6 months, success in this role would look like:**


* **Structured, consistent onboarding process**
* **Clear and well\-managed recruitment pipeline**
* **Improved ATS usage and visibility**
* **SOPs and training materials live and in use**
* **Clear HR metrics and reporting**
* **Reduced reliance on ad hoc communication**
* **Stronger process consistency and compliance**

**What we are looking for**


* **Experience in HR operations, people operations, or a similar role in a growing business**
* **Experience in HR operations / people operations in a growing business**
* **Strong experience in recruitment, onboarding, and process improvement**
* **Proven ability to build and implement processes (not just support them)**
* **Experience using and improving an ATS**
* **Good judgment on using AI/automation vs human decision\-making**
* **Strong organisation, attention to detail, and follow\-through**
* **Comfortable working in an unstructured, scaling environment**
* **Strong communication and stakeholder management skills**
* **Practical understanding of UK HR processes and compliance**
* **Experience with systems such as ADP, Notion, or similar tools**

**Especially strong candidates will be able to show examples of:**


* **Building onboarding or HR processes from scratch**
* **Creating SOPs or training systems**
* **Improving hiring speed, structure, or quality**
* **Introducing KPI tracking or reporting**
* **Improving ATS workflows or automation**
* **Bringing structure to previously inconsistent environments**

description:
**Where Your Passion Meets Purpose: Empowering Millions through Insurance!**  

**About Ditto**


Ditto’s mission is to help people make well\-informed insurance decisions — from expert advisory and policy purchases to dedicated claim support. We pioneered the industry\-first “No\-spam” policy, and over the past three years, we’ve assisted over 700,000 users with personalised advice on health and term insurance. We carry a 4\.9 rating with 14,000\+ reviews on Google.


Ditto is part of the Finshots family (500K\+ subscribers) and is backed by Zerodha, India’s largest stockbroker. We won LinkedIn’s Top Startup award in both 2022 and 2023\.

**The Context**


In 2024, Ditto was a team of 350\. By 2025, we were 700\. Today, we’re at 1,400 — and we’ll cross 2,000 by the start of 2027\.


Ditto is a service company. Our people are our product — the quality of advice we give customers is only as good as the people giving it. How well we hire, how well we retain good talent, and how well we develop them directly determines how well the company grows. At our scale, getting this wrong isn’t a minor inefficiency — it’s an existential risk.


Growth at this pace breaks things. Hiring processes that worked at 350 don’t hold at 1,400\. Retention strategies that were informal now need structure. Performance systems that were manager\-dependent now need to be organisation\-wide. This role exists to fix what’s breaking and to build what doesn’t exist yet.

**The Role**


You will report to the HR Lead and work closely with the co\-founders on two critical problem areas. Depending on your experience and expertise, you’ll own one of these:

**Problem Area 1: Hiring at Speed Without Dropping the Bar**


We need to close roles faster while ensuring quality doesn’t slip. This means:

* Redesigning hiring workflows to reduce time\-to\-close across roles
* Building reliable, sustainable sourcing channels that don’t depend on a single pipeline
* Identifying bottlenecks in the current process and implementing fixes that hold at scale

**Problem Area 2: Talent Management \& Retention for a 2,500\-Person Organisation**


Our current people systems were built for a much smaller team. This means:

* Revamping talent management frameworks — performance cycles, career progression, development paths
* Rethinking employee retention policies so they work at 2,500 people, not just 700
* Ensuring our systems are robust enough to run smoothly as the organisation continues to scale

**How This Role Evolves**


The first six months will be about understanding how our current systems operate, identifying what needs to change, and designing better ones — but not just on paper. We expect you to start executing early. You’ll work closely with the co\-founders and HR team to get the foundations right, but you’ll also be measured on what you ship, not just what you propose.


After six months, based on how things shape up, this role could go one of two ways: you take ownership of the entire function you’ve built, or you move to the next 0\-to\-1 problem. The same applies to team structure — whether this becomes a team\-lead role or stays as a high\-impact IC will depend on the work and your trajectory.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4\+ years of experience in HR business partnering, people operations, org consulting, or a generalist Founder’s Office role with strong HR exposure
* Experience in a startup that went through a significant scaling phase, or at an established company with a large, complex team — you’ve seen what happens when organisations grow fast
* Deep understanding of HR systems and people processes — not just theory, but how things actually work on the ground
* Strong analytical ability with comfort working with people data and dashboards
* Clear, structured communicator who can influence both leadership and cross\-functional teams
* High ownership mindset — you operate independently and drive outcomes without waiting for direction
* Ability to build relationships, earn trust quickly, and navigate ambiguity with confidence

  

A note on what this role is not: We’re not looking for someone who advises from the sidelines. This role requires you to get your hands dirty — to design systems, yes, but also to execute projects on your own when needed. If you’re looking for a pure advisory or consulting role, this isn’t the right fit

**Why Join Ditto**

* Work on high\-priority problems with direct business impact — not maintenance work
* A front\-row seat to how a fast\-growing startup scales its people function
* Exposure to multiple verticals and a real path to leadership roles
* Direct access to co\-founders and the opportunity to shape how the organisation operates

**Perks**

* Comprehensive health and term insurance
* ESOPs
* Compensation as per industry standards

**Our Interview Process**


We respect your time. There are 4 rounds, and we aim to complete all of them within 2 weeks.

* Introductory call with HR
* Task submission
* Task presentation \+ Managerial round
* Founders round

**This is an in\-office role (with flexibility for remote working). Our address is: Fortuna\-1, No 680, 15th Cross, J.P Nagar 2nd Phase, J P Nagar, Bangalore, Bangalore South – 560078, Karnataka, India.**

***Please Note:*** *Beware of recruitment scams. Ditto does not charge any fees for the hiring process. We’ve seen fraudulent hiring messages impersonating Ditto. Please verify any communication through our official channels.*

Locations: Mumbai

About Cityflo

Cityflo is a daily commute company that provides a comfortable, stress\-free travel experience for corporate professionals, as an alternative to driving. With premium buses, a simple app, and caring customer service, our passengers get the luxury of time in their busy schedules — where they can read a book, watch Netflix, nap, or simply soak in the view of the city. ● App: https://bnc.lt/cityflo/

● Blog: https://blog.cityflo.com/

● Our journey through Covid: https://bit.ly/3wBiSZx

Role Overview –

The Associate \- HR Driver Development will be responsible for leading and managing the driver sourcing, onboarding, training, and engagement function. This is a people leadership role, focused on driving team performance, process excellence, and sourcing outcomes. The role requires the ability to guide, mentor, and monitor the driver development team, ensure achievement of sourcing targets, maintain compliance, and build a strong driver culture aligned with Cityflo’s service standards. The Lead will own daily reporting, performance tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives, and act as the primary point of escalation for driver\-related matters.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership \& Performance

● Lead, mentor, and supervise the driver sourcing and onboarding team to achieve defined sourcing goals. ● Set daily, weekly, and monthly targets and monitor team productivity and effectiveness.

● Review team performance regularly and provide coaching, feedback, and corrective actions where required.

Driver Sourcing \& Onboarding Oversight

● Oversee end\-to\-end driver sourcing and onboarding processes, ensuring quality and timely closures.

● Step in to support calls or onboarding activities when required, but primarily focus on team direction and oversight.

● Ensure smooth scheduling of driving tests and onboarding sessions.

Reporting \& Process Management

● Own daily reporting on driver sourcing, onboarding status, and pipeline health.

● Maintain accurate data, MIS, and compliance documentation.

● Identify process gaps and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and scale.

Insurance, Welfare \& Compliance

● Oversee driver insurance additions/deletions and support claim settlements.

● Ensure compliance with documentation, statutory, and internal policy requirements. Training, Performance \& Counselling

● Plan and oversee driver training programs (soft skills, rash driving prevention, BS6, safety standards, etc.). ● Handle escalations related to driver behaviour, complaints, and performance issues through counselling and corrective action plans.

Driver Engagement \& Culture

● Drive initiatives to foster a positive and respectful driver culture.

● Plan hub meetings, engagement activities, and welfare initiatives (meals, gifts, water supply, vendor coordination).

● Act as the voice of drivers by collecting feedback and collaborating with internal teams for resolution.

Skills \& Competencies

● Strong people management and leadership skills.

● Excellent communication and counselling abilities (Hindi, Marathi, English preferred).

● Analytical mindset with the ability to track performance, interpret data, and drive results.

● Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.

● Proactive, solution\-oriented approach to driver welfare and team effectiveness.

Qualifications \& Experience

● Graduate in any discipline.

● 3–6 years of experience in driver onboarding, operations, logistics, or people management roles.

● Prior experience leading or mentoring teams is mandatory.

● Experience in blue collar sourcing, hiring, or engagement will be an added advantage.

\- Use precision measuring instruments such as vernier calipers, micrometers, dial gauges, bore gauges, height gauges, and thread gauges to verify dimensional accuracy

\- Carry out visual inspection to identify surface defects, burrs, cracks, or workmanship issues

\- Verify surface finish, geometric tolerances, and form, fit, and function requirements of machined and fabricated parts

\- Perform first\-article inspection and batch inspection as per the defined sampling plan

**Measuring Instruments and Calibration**

\- Select and apply the correct measuring instrument for each inspection requirement

\- Ensure all gauges and instruments are properly calibrated, maintained, and stored

\- Maintain calibration records and coordinate periodic calibration schedules with the quality lab team

\- Report any instrument malfunction or out\-of\-calibration status to the supervisor immediately

**Non\-Conformance and Rejection Handling**

\- Identify, tag, and segregate non\-conforming components from the production line

\- Raise Non\-Conformance Reports (NCR) for defective parts with clear documentation of defect type, location, and extent

\- Coordinate with the production team to investigate the root cause of rejections

\- Verify that reworked or repaired parts meet acceptance criteria before re\-inspection and release

**Documentation and Quality Records**

\- Maintain accurate inspection records, measurement data sheets, and shift\-wise quality logs

\- Prepare daily inspection reports and submit to the QC supervisor or engineer

\- Update rejection logs, scrap records, and rework registers as required

\- Support preparation of dimensional inspection reports and first\-article inspection documents for customer review

**Engineering Drawing Interpretation**

\- Read and interpret 2D engineering drawings, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD\&T) symbols, and technical specifications

\- Understand material grades, surface treatment requirements, and dimensional tolerances as specified on drawings

\- Ensure all production components conform to approved drawings before they proceed to the next stage

**Incoming Quality Control**

\- Inspect incoming raw materials and bought\-out components as per the acceptance sampling plan

\- Verify material test certificates, grade markings, and compliance with procurement specifications

\- Accept, reject, or place on hold incoming materials and raise Goods Inspection Reports (GIR) accordingly

**Shop Floor Quality Support**

\- Work alongside machine operators and production staff to provide real\-time quality feedback on the shop floor

\- Guide operators on correct use of inspection tools and proper measurement techniques

\- Support machine setup approvals and first\-off part verification at the start of each batch or shift

\- Participate in 5S activities and housekeeping in the quality control area

**Continuous Improvement**

\- Identify repetitive defects and contribute to root cause analysis and corrective action discussions

\- Support implementation of quality improvement initiatives and process controls on the shop floor

\- Report quality trends and recurring issues to the senior QC engineer or manager

**Skills and Knowledge Required**

\- Good understanding of mechanical engineering fundamentals including tolerances, fits, surface finish, and material properties

\- Hands\-on knowledge of precision measuring instruments commonly used in a mechanical production environment

\- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and GD\&T symbols

\- Basic understanding of manufacturing processes such as machining, fabrication, casting, or sheet metal work

\- Familiarity with quality control concepts including inspection plans, sampling methods, and rejection criteria

\- Good attention to detail and ability to work accurately in a shop floor environment

\- Basic computer skills for maintaining records and preparing reports

**Added Advantage**

\- Prior internship or project work in a manufacturing, production, or quality department

\- Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management system requirements

\- Basic knowledge of quality tools such as 5\-Why analysis, cause and effect diagrams, or 8D problem solving

\- Exposure to coordinate measuring machines (CMM) or optical profile projectors

**What We Offer**

\- Hands\-on experience in a live manufacturing environment from the first day of joining

\- Structured day shift with fixed working hours from Monday to Saturday

\- Practical training on precision instruments, quality standards, and inspection processes

\- A clear career growth path in core mechanical quality engineering

\- A professional and collaborative team environment

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400 employees and 70,000 customers across 100 countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content.


Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.


Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.


Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.


**Build Your Career with Cyncly in Kochi**  

Kochi is Cyncly’s newest hub, opening doors to exciting career opportunities across diverse functions. Here, you’ll collaborate with global experts, engage in innovative projects, and grow in a culture that values innovation, flexibility, and continuous learning. With access to top mentors, excellent learning resources, and a flexible and autonomous working environment, you’ll have everything you need to thrive.


Make it amazing—take your career to the next level with Cyncly in Kochi!


**About Role**

Join a world leader in Cloud based software solution for the Space Designing industry. As a **Software Engineer,** you will work on the Cyncly SaaS products like Spaces Flex \- a 3D WEB interior/exterior design software with End\-to\-End integration with eCommerce, Order Management and other CRM solutions as well as content platforms.


Our engineering team is made up of SaaS skilled developers, architects and team leads and we have openings for other developers in the team. If you are looking for a challenging product development that offers learning and growth opportunities, apply for this position  



**Responsibility**

* Develop code that is performance\-oriented, cost\-effective, and follows company\-defined security standards.
* Elaborate interfaces using standards and design principles defined by the team.
* Develop systems with high availability.
* Well versed with Unit testing and PSR Standards.
* Master Software Development lifecycle, standards and technologies used by the team.
* Deliver on time with high quality.
* Write Automation tests to help out Automation SIT team.
* Trouble Shooting and debugging skills for faster defect fixing.
* Perform technical documentation of the implemented tasks.
* Provide guidance and mentoring to Interns/Freshers and other programmers.
* Identifies and recommends areas appropriate for further study and participates in any Proof of Concept projects required to thoroughly investigate architectural possibilities and strengthen arguments for their adoption
* Identifies implementation risks and analyses potential impact on the enterprise and on the achievement of scheduled objectives
Recommends and participates in the design and implementation of standards, tools and methodologies.  
* 

**You Must Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Computers OR IT\-related courses.
* 0\-3 years of experience working in an agile environment with full stack development.
* **Must have:**
	+ Proficiency in front\-end technologies such as HTML, SCSS, **Tailwind** , JavaScript, **TypeScript** , and experience with frameworks like **ReactJS,** VueJS, or BackboneJS.
	+ Good understanding on back ed technologies like NodeJS, C\#, Microservices, and .NET Core.
	+ Good understanding with NoSQL databases like **MongoDB** .
	+ Proficiency in unit testing frameworks like JEST.
	+ Troubleshooting and debugging skills for issues and performance bottlenecks
	+ Cross\-browser and cross\-platform compatibility knowledge.
	+ Participation in code reviews and adherence to coding standards.
	+ Must have experience on **responsive and adaptive UI** development (Tablet and Phone based web app development)

**Good to Have:**

* Experience with state management libraries like React Zustand or similar.
* Knowledge of the NX mono repo framework.
* Good understanding of Azure services and infrastructure.
* Strong grasp of SOLID design principles and design patterns.
* Ability to develop and optimize web pages for speed and scalability.
* Growth mindset and team player mentality.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced technology environment focused on delivering a world class product within an agile methodology utilizing latest technology frameworks.
* Technological mindset that keeps up on the latest technology, best practices and continues to learn and apply those learning's to the Cyncly environment
Demonstrated ability to effectively establish and maintain working relationships across disciplines and across the organization  
* 

  

**We Value**

* Good working knowledge of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery Practices
* Experience with test driven development and Microservices architecture.
* Knowledgeable in common SCM practices, such as branching and code merges
* Ability to work within a Team with strong analytical, problem\-solving and communication skills
* Flexible and adaptable; able to work in ambiguous situations.
* Experience working within an Agile team
* Ability to influence others and move toward a common vision or goal.
Understanding of Agile practices and ability to use tools such as Azure DevOps to enable the delivery of high\-quality code  
* 

**Working for Us**  

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.


Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.


We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone \- from every background \- to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.


If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in \- come join us.

title: SDR (Sales Development Representative), Personal Insurance
description:
**About Plum**


Plum is on a mission to make health insurance simple, accessible, and genuinely useful for modern organizations. Backed by Tiger Global and Peak XV Partners, we've built a product people love and now we're scaling it to reach 10 million lives by FY2030\.

**About Plum Personal**


Plum Personal is a new venture being built within Plum, and this is one of the earliest roles in it. If you're just starting out and want to learn what it actually takes to build a business from the ground up, this is a better education than most.


Freshers, final\-year students, and candidates with up to 1 year of work experience are encouraged to apply. We also offer a 6\-month internship track for those not ready for a full\-time commitment yet.

**What You'll Do**

* Talk to real customers every day, over the phone, on video, and over email, and help them find the right life insurance product for their needs.
* Stay on top of your leads pipeline and make sure no prospect is left waiting or falling through the cracks.
* Learn how to navigate a full sales cycle alongside experienced teammates and insurer partners.
* Support day\-to\-day operations around policy booking, placement, and post\-sales, understanding that the job doesn't end at the sale.
* Bring energy and curiosity to every interaction. Customers can tell when someone actually cares.

**What We're Looking For**

* Freshers or candidates with up to 1 year of work experience. Final\-year students open to a 6\-month internship are welcome too.
* Someone who can hold a conversation, clear, confident, and credible whether in person, on a call, or over email.
* The ability to explain something complex and make it feel simple. That's a skill, and we'll help you sharpen it.
* Comfort with targets. You'll have them, and we want someone who's motivated by them rather than stressed by them.
* A genuine eagerness to learn. This role has a steep learning curve and that's exactly the point.
* Any prior exposure to insurance, financial services, or personal finance is a bonus, not a requirement.

**Why This Role**


Most early\-career roles hand you a script and a headset. This one gives you real customers, real conversations, and real stakes from week one. You'll learn how insurance actually works, what it takes to earn a customer's trust, and how to build a career in sales with a strong foundation under you.

*We're building the future of workplace health and we need people who feel that in their work.*

description:
We are seeking a disciplined and result\-oriented **Sales Executive** to manage our brand’s presence across Gurgaon. You will be responsible for ensuring product availability and premium placement across various liquor outlets. This role requires daily field visits, strong relationship management, and meticulous reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Inventory Audits:** Visit assigned liquor stores (L\-2\) daily to check stock levels and ensure no "out\-of\-stock" scenarios.
* **Merchandising \& Placement:** Ensure our products are prominently displayed in high\-visibility areas (chillers, shelf eye\-level) and that branding materials are intact.
* **Relationship Management:** Act as the primary point of contact for store managers and staff to ensure our brand receives priority.
* **Market Intelligence:** Provide daily updates on stock movement, competitor pricing, and new product launches in the area.
* **Logistics Coordination:** Work closely with the distribution team to ensure timely replenishment based on outlet demand.

**Requirements \& Skills**

* **Mandatory:** Must own a two\-wheeler (scooter/bike) and have a valid driving license.
* **Experience:** Freshers are welcome. Experienced professionals in field sales (FMCG, Alco\-bev, or Beverage industry preferred).
* **Communication:** Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to negotiate and influence outlet staff.
* **Local Geography:** Excellent knowledge of Gurgaon sectors and major liquor retail hubs.
* **Reporting:** Basic proficiency in using mobile apps for daily attendance and stock reporting.

**Compensation, Schedule \& Perks**

* **Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹50,000 per month.
* **Fuel Allowance:** Reimbursed on an **actual basis** (conveyance provided per kilometer/actual usage).
* **Weekly Off:** Every **Tuesday**.
* **Holidays:** Paid holidays on all **Dry Days** (as per Haryana government regulations).

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates who meet the transportation and experience requirements are invited to apply. Please highlight your experience in the Gurgaon market in your application.

The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check\-ups but also

\*Following the 12\-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check\-up

5\) Store upkeep \& maintenance  
\*Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP

title: HR Business Partner (Part-Time Remote) | D2C Gardening Ecommerce | ₹30-40K/month
description:
🌱
 **About OrganicBazar** 




 OrganicBazar is NOT a startup burning VC money. We're a bootstrapped, profitable D2C gardening ecommerce brand that's built real scale:
 


* 15,000–20,000\+ orders per month
* Channels: Shopify (own site) \+ Amazon \+ Meesho
* Logistics: Delhivery (6 active accounts), Shiprocket
* Warehouse: Narsinghpur, MP — seeds, grow bags, fertilizers, tools, planters
* Expanding: Live plants D2C shipping (launching from Pune/Kadiyam nurseries)
* Multi\-state: MP, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Haryana, Telangana, UP



 We need an HRBP who thinks like a business operator, not just an HR administrator.
 



 💼
 **What You'll Own (Not Just "Do")** 




 This isn't a task list — these are outcomes you're accountable for:
 



 𝟏. 𝐇𝐑 𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐧𝐞𝐫 𝐀𝐮𝐝𝐢𝐭 \& 𝐃𝐞𝐜𝐢𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 Our outsourced HR partner (Emgage) has service gaps. You audit their performance in Week 1, present a recommendation in Week 3: keep, renegotiate, or replace. If replace — you lead the transition.
 



 𝟐. 𝐖𝐨𝐫𝐤𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐜𝐞 𝐏𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐓𝐢𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐁𝐮𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐃𝐚𝐭𝐚 Build a headcount model: warehouse packers, dispatch staff, CX agents — mapped to monthly order forecast. Current: 15–20K orders/month. Diwali peak: 30K\+. Monsoon: seeds spike 3x. Answer: "How many people do we need in July vs December?" with data, not guesswork.
 



 𝟑. 𝐌𝐮𝐥𝐭𝐢\-𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐥𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐀𝐫𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞 6 GSTIN registrations across 6 states. PF/ESIC/PT filings must be accurate. You own the compliance calendar and ensure everything is filed correctly and on time.
 



 𝟒. 𝐎𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐑𝐞𝐜𝐫𝐮𝐢𝐭𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐏𝐢𝐩𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐞 5–15 hires/month: warehouse packers, dispatch operators, customer support. Build sourcing channels that work for Tier 3 town (Narsinghpur) hiring — local networks, not just Naukri/LinkedIn.
 



 𝟓. 𝐋𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐏𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐬 𝐋𝐚𝐮𝐧𝐜𝐡 — 𝐍𝐞𝐰 𝐕𝐞𝐫𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐥 𝐇𝐑 𝐒𝐞𝐭𝐮𝐩 New dispatch team, DOA/damage SOP, specialized packaging staff — build the hiring plan and SOPs from scratch.
 



 𝟔. 𝐏𝐨𝐥𝐢𝐜𝐲 \& 𝐂𝐮𝐥𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐅𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 Leave policy, attendance, disciplinary process, exit guidelines. Hindi \+ English SOPs. Build a fair grievance mechanism — we had a warehouse walkout; it can't happen again.
 



 ✅
 **Must\-Have Requirements** 



* 5\+ years HR experience with at least 2 years as HRBP/HR Manager (not recruitment\-only)
* Hands\-on PF \+ ESIC challan generation and filing (not just supervision)
* Professional Tax (PT) compliance experience
* Hired for warehouse/factory/dispatch/CS/blue\-collar operations roles
* Comfortable with part\-time remote work (4–5 hrs/day) with daily reporting
* Willing to visit Narsinghpur, MP warehouse 2–3 days/month (reimbursed)



 ⭐
 **We'll Pay Top of Budget (₹40K) If You've Worked At:** 



* Ecommerce/D2C: Flipkart, Amazon, Meesho, Nykaa, BigBasket, Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy, Lenskart, FirstCry, or any D2C brand
* Logistics/Courier: Delhivery, Ecom Express, Xpressbees, BlueDart, Shadowfax, Ekart
* Gardening/Agri ecommerce: Ugaoo, Kyari, NurseryLive, TrustBasket, The Earth Store (DIRECT competitor \= instant interview)
* Manufacturing/Plant HR/Factory Act background



 🚫
 **This Role is NOT for You If:** 



* You think HR \= only recruitment. This is a business partnership role.
* You've only worked in IT/services HR. Warehouse \+ blue\-collar is a different world.
* You can't work in Hindi. Our warehouse team speaks Hindi.
* You won't travel to a Tier 3 town. Narsinghpur is where the action is.



 🎁
 **What You Get:** 



* ₹30–40K/month for 4–5 hours/day — effective rate of ₹60–80K if compared to full\-time
* Direct line to Founder — your recommendations get implemented, not filed away
* Build HR from scratch for a profitable, scaling D2C brand
* Flexible schedule — morning or evening slot, your choice
* Monthly travel reimbursed
* If you deliver, this grows into a full\-time leadership role

title: Senior People Operations Specialist (APAC)
description:

Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
   

  

**Our vision:** 
 A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 The Senior People Operations Specialist (APAC) is the primary operational owner for Wrike’s India workforce and a key execution partner for People Operations across APAC, including Japan and Australia. This role strengthens the operational backbone of Wrike by ensuring that employee lifecycle processes, payroll operations, benefits administration, and compliance practices are accurate, scalable, and employee\-centric across multiple jurisdictions, with particular depth in India’s regulatory and payroll environment.
   

  

**Your Impact:**
* Employee Lifecycle Execution:
+ Lead end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes across India, Japan, and Australia (onboarding, internal mobility, compensation changes, leave transitions, and offboarding).
+ Ensure all lifecycle changes are accurately reflected in HR systems and aligned with payroll and compliance requirements.
+ Partner with HRBPs, Payroll, Finance, IT, and local leadership to coordinate seamless transitions and deliver clear, timely employee communication.
+ Identify friction points in lifecycle processes and implement scalable improvements.

* Payroll Ownership (APAC):
+ Serve as the operational lead for payroll readiness across APAC, with deep ownership of India payroll complexity.
+ Validate CTC structures, allowances, variable pay, overtime, and payroll\-impacting changes, especially India statutory components.
+ Monitor attendance integrations, shift data, and salary calculations to safeguard payroll accuracy.
+ Maintain statutory deduction accuracy and monthly compliance requirements in India, while supporting alignment across Japan and Australia.

* Benefits, Leave \& Wellness Programs:
+ Administer and improve benefits and leave programs across APAC in line with local regulations and global standards.
+ Manage country\-specific health, retirement, insurance, and statutory leave programs in partnership with vendors and internal stakeholders.
+ Act as a trusted point of contact for employees on benefits and leave, strengthening communication and education across regions.
+ Identify opportunities to streamline and standardize processes while respecting local nuances.

* HR Governance, Compliance \& Risk Stewardship:
+ Ensure operational integrity and regulatory alignment across India, Japan, and Australia.
+ Support audit readiness, regulatory reporting, and statutory documentation.
+ Monitor regulatory developments and assess their operational impact.
+ Maintain defensible documentation standards and system integrity in all People Ops processes.

The role involves collaborative efforts with various departments to ensure smooth and precise data management, including position management, offboarding, and absence tracking.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Data Integrity and Management

* Demonstrate a methodical and organized approach to work situations with high attention to detail.
* Offboarding
* Manage the offboarding process by initiating separation in the HR system based online managers approval
* Ensure compliance with company policies and legal requirements during the offboarding process.
* Coordinate with various departments to ensure a smooth transition for exiting employees in HR Systems.
* Absence Management
* Track and manage employee absences, including leave requests, sick days, and vacation days in HR Systems.
* Updating year end activities holiday calendar, work schedule, general queries.
* Ensure accurate recording of absences in the HR system and compliance with company policies.
* Compliance and Confidentiality
* Maintain strict confidentiality of employee data and adhere to privacy laws, local legislation, and company policies.
* Ensure compliance with data protection regulations and internal data management guidelines.
* Interdepartmental Collaboration
* Work closely with HR and payroll to resolve any discrepancies in employee data.
* Collaborate with other departments to ensure accurate and timely data management.
* Process Improvement
* Identify and suggest improvements in data management processes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
* Engage in HR system improvement projects or data migration activities.
* Query Management
* Respond to data\-related queries from employees and management in a timely and professional manner.
* Provide support and guidance on data management best practices.


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* 1\-3 years of experience in HR data management or a related role, preferably in a shared services environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Good knowledge of HR Systems such as Success Factor, ServiceNow, and HRIS is an added advantage.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and integrity.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.


 The skills for success
   

  

 Data and Analytics, HR Process Improvement; Process management; HR Process improvement, Storytelling; Data led storytelling, Strategic mindset, Digital literacy, HR Data Analsyis; Data management; Employee data management, Commercial accumen, Solutioning.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality

title: Technical Support Executive
description:
Position Overview
   

  

 The Technical Support Executive will be responsible for providing end\-to\-end technical assistance, installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and customer support for IT infrastructure solutions. This role requires hands\-on experience across networking, server architecture, security systems, wireless solutions, surveillance, data backup \& recovery, cloud services (Microsoft 365 \& Azure), and virtualization technologies.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong problem\-solving skills, excellent communication abilities, and a customer\-first mindset.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Technical Support \& Troubleshooting


 Provide L1/L2 technical support to clients for IT infrastructure and network\-related issues.
   

  

 Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, software, network, and system\-related incidents.
   

  

 Perform remote and onsite support as required.
   

  

 Escalate critical issues to senior engineers or OEMs when necessary.
   

  

* Network Infrastructure Management


 Assist in configuration and troubleshooting of:
   

  

 Routers, switches, firewalls, VLANs, VPN, DHCP, DNS, NAT, routing protocols
   

  

 Wireless access points and controllers
   

  

 Conduct network health checks, performance monitoring, and optimization.
   

  

* Server \& Systems Support


 Provide support for Windows Server, Linux Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP.
   

  

 Assist in server deployment, patching, updates, and resource monitoring.
   

  

 Support Hyper\-V / VMware virtualization environments.
   

  

* Security \& Surveillance Solutions


 Basic troubleshooting of firewall security policies and endpoint security.
   

  

 Provide support for CCTV / IP surveillance systems (NVR, DVR, VMS, camera configurations).
   

  

 Assist in implementing security best practices and monitoring tools.
   

  

* Data Backup, DC\-DR \& Business Continuity


 Support installation and configuration of backup solutions (Veeam, Synology, NAS, cloud backup, etc.).
   

  

 Monitor scheduled backups and ensure recovery readiness.
   

  

 Assist in DC/DR drills, failover/failback operations.
   

  

* Cloud Solutions (Microsoft 365 \& Azure)


 Provide support for:
   

  

 Microsoft 365 administration (user management, email, SharePoint, OneDrive)
   

  

 Azure services (VMs, backup, policies, access management)
   

  

 Troubleshoot cloud service issues and assist clients with migrations.
   

  

* Documentation \& Reporting


 Maintain accurate records of service requests, resolutions, and technical procedures.
   

  

 Prepare daily/weekly reports related to support activities.
   

  

 Update knowledge base and maintain configuration documentation.
   

  

* Customer Engagement


 Handle client queries professionally and provide timely updates.
   

  

 Educate customers on system usage, best practices, and preventive maintenance.
   

  

 Build strong customer relationships to enhance service satisfaction.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Required Skills \& Qualifications
   

  

 Diploma / Graduate in IT, Computer Science, or related field.
   

  

 1–3 years of experience in technical support or IT infrastructure roles (fresher with strong technical knowledge may also apply).
   

  

 Working knowledge of:
   

  

 Networking equipment (Cisco, Sophos, Sonicwall,Palo Alto, Juniper, Dell, Lenovo, HP/Aruba, Fortinet, etc.)
   

  

 Windows Server, AD, virtualization (Hyper\-V/VMware)
   

  

 Firewall policies and endpoint security
   

  

 Microsoft 365 \& Azure administration
   

  

 IP surveillance systems
   

  

 Backup and disaster recovery tools
   

  

 Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
   

  

 Good communication skills (verbal and written).
   

  

**Preferred Certifications (Optional But An Advantage)**
 CCNA / CCNP
   

  

 MCSA / AZ\-900 / MS\-900
   

  

 Veeam VMCE / VMware VCA
   

  

 CompTIA Network\+ / Security\+
   

  

 Fortinet NSE certifications
   

  

 Any relevant OEM certifications (Aruba, Cisco, Dell, Microsoft)
   

  

 Work Environment
   

  

 Onsite \+ remote hybrid support depending on client requirements.
   

  

 Occasional travel to client locations for deployment or troubleshooting.
   

  

 Must be able to work in a fast\-paced system integrator environment with diverse technologies.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Opportunity to work on multi\-vendor technologies across networking, servers, cloud, and cybersecurity.
   

  

 Certification support and continuous technical training programs.
   

  

 Attractive salary package with performance incentives.
   

  

 Mobile and travel allowance for client visits.
   

  

 Health insurance and PF (as per company policy).
   

  

 Friendly work culture with strong learning and growth opportunities.
   

  

 Access to OEM tools, labs, and partner training resources.

**About PeopleHum**
 peopleHum is a Human Capital Platform, built for the next decade, we're on a mission to transform "The Future of Work". The winner of the 2019 Global Codie award, used by organizations around the world.

**Role Overview**
 We’re hiring a
 **Network Engineer (SaaS / Cloud Networking)** 
 with
 **1–2 years of experience** 
 to help keep our platform
 **reachable, fast, and secure** 
 because in SaaS, “networking” is not just about cables and routers. It’s about
 **cloud networking, traffic routing, DNS, security controls** 
 , and making sure customers can log in and use the product without drama.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with DevOps/SRE and Security teams to support day\-to\-day network operations, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and maintain reliable cloud network setups. You’ll also support our on\-ground network stack where needed—especially around
 **Fortigate firewall setups** 
 and
 **Ruckus Wireless** 
 environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Support day\-to\-day network operations across production and non\-production environments
* Assist with cloud networking components: VPC/VNet, subnets, route tables, NAT/Internet gateways, security groups/NACLs
* Help maintain traffic layers like DNS, load balancers, SSL/TLS basics, and (where applicable) CDN/WAF support
* Troubleshoot issues like timeouts, latency spikes, DNS misrouting, SSL handshake errors, VPN/IP allowlisting problems
* Support secure access requirements: IP whitelisting, VPN connectivity, and basic access control checks
* Assist in configuring and managing Fortigate firewalls (policies, NAT rules, VPN basics, logs, and access controls)
* Support office and hybrid environments using Ruckus Wireless (AP health checks, connectivity troubleshooting, basic configuration support)
* Maintain and update network documentation (diagrams, SOPs, runbooks, change logs)
* Assist in setting up and maintaining monitoring/alerting for network health and uptime
* Participate in incident response support: triage, issue isolation, RCA inputs, and follow\-up fixes
* Coordinate with DevOps/SRE to ensure changes are safe and production\-ready (no “oops” deployments)


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 1–2 years of experience in Network Engineering / NOC / Cloud Ops / IT Infra support
* Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, routing basics, SSL/TLS concepts
* Comfortable with Linux basics (network commands, logs, troubleshooting)
* Exposure to at least one cloud platform (AWS / Azure / GCP) and basic networking concepts within it
* Understanding of security basics: firewalls, access rules, security groups, least privilege mindset
* Basic familiarity with firewall operations (policy rules, NAT, VPN concepts, log checks)—Fortigate exposure is a plus
* Ability to write clear issue reports with reproduction steps, evidence, and impact (network bugs need good storytelling)


**DISCLAIMER: This position is open only for candidates in Mumbai. Applications from other locations will not be considered**
**Qualifications**
 Must have skills
   

  

* Hands\-on familiarity with Fortigate (FortiGate) firewall: firewall policies, NAT, VPN basics, troubleshooting via logs
* Experience with Ruckus Wireless: AP troubleshooting, controller basics, connectivity issue diagnosis
* Familiarity with AWS Route 53 / ELB / CloudFront (or equivalent Azure/GCP services)
* Exposure to WAF/DDoS concepts (Cloudflare, AWS WAF, etc.)
* Basic knowledge of Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
* Any experience with monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Grafana, Datadog, ELK, Prometheus)
* Basic scripting (Bash/Python) to automate repetitive operational tasks
* Curiosity about how SaaS systems break at scale and how to prevent repeat incidents

**Job Description**
**Job Description**
 We’re looking for an experienced
 **Network Engineer** 
 to design, implement, and maintain our global network infrastructure. This role combines technical expertise with hands\-on execution across wired and wireless networks, audiovisual systems, and office expansion projects. You’ll play a key role in ensuring that our global workforce stays connected, secure, and supported through reliable and scalable network solutions.
   

  

 If you thrive in a collaborative, people\-first environment and value humility, humor, self\-awareness, and quality, you’ll feel right at home here. We’re looking for someone who’s just as comfortable optimizing network performance and troubleshooting complex issues as they are contributing to AV design standards or supporting new office build\-outs.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Network Design \& Implementation: Design, configure, and deploy secure, scalable LAN/WAN and wireless solutions across global offices.
* Maintenance \& Operations: Monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot network infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and uptime.
* Security \& Compliance: Implement and maintain firewalls, VPNs, and access controls in alignment with security and compliance standards.
* AV \& Collaboration Support: Support and maintain AV systems and conferencing technology for hybrid meetings and corporate events.
* Office Expansion Projects: Partner with Workplace and IT teams to plan and execute network infrastructure for new offices and expansions.
* Monitoring \& Optimization: Use tools such as Logic Monitor, Aruba Dashboard, or equivalent platforms to monitor performance, identify issues, and improve reliability.
* Documentation: Maintain accurate documentation of network topology, configurations, and standard operating procedures.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with endpoint, collaboration, and security teams to ensure seamless technology integration and user experience.
* Vendor Management: Coordinate with external vendors and service providers to procure, install, and support networking and AV hardware.


**Why Join Us**
* You’ll have a direct impact on the performance, reliability, and scalability of our global IT infrastructure.
* We prioritize thoughtful, data\-driven decisions and encourage innovation through experimentation.
* Our team values humor, honesty, and collaboration, creating a culture where you can be yourself and do your best work.
* We support continuous learning and growth with opportunities to explore new technologies and expand your technical skill set.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Experience: 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in network engineering or infrastructure operations, preferably in a global or multi\-site environment.


**Technical Skills**
* Core Networking: A deep and demonstrable understanding of fundamental networking concepts, including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing/switching protocols (e.g., BGP, OSPF), VPNs, DNS, and DHCP.
* Hardware Platforms: Hands\-on experience with networking platforms from major vendors such as Cisco, Aruba, Palo Alto, and/or other equivalent enterprise\-grade hardware.
* Emerging Technologies: Familiarity with and/or experience in modern networking technologies, including SD\-WAN, cloud networking (AWS) and Network Monitoring Tools
* Security \& SaaS: Experience with security platforms and cloud\-native solutions, with Netskope experience being a plus.
* Collaboration Systems: Working knowledge of AV systems and conferencing technologies (e.g., Zoom Rooms, Neat).
* Other Beneficial Skills: Any experience with scripting/automation (e.g., Python, Ansible) or network automation tools is a plus.


**Soft Skills**
* Problem\-Solving: Excellent problem\-solving abilities, with a proven track record of using Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to identify underlying issues and implement sustainable solutions.
* Communication: Clear and effective communication, both written and verbal, particularly in the context of creating and documenting change control procedures.
* Collaboration: A collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross\-functionally and manage stakeholder relationships during the change control process.

title: Battery Energy Storage System - Design Engineering
description:
The BESS Engineering team member will be responsible for the technical design, engineering, and integration of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) across the company’s renewable energy portfolio. This role will drive technical due diligence, system architecture, vendor evaluation, detailed design, and support project execution from concept to commissioning, ensuring safe, reliable, and cost\-effective deployment of BESS projects.
 



**Roles And Responsibilities** 




**Technical Expertise** 



* Work on engineering of utility\-scale BESS projects (standalone and hybrid with solar/wind). BESS sizing and Modeling of RTC Projects with BESS
* Define system architecture, sizing, and configuration based on project requirements and grid codes.
* Develop and review single\-line diagrams, system layouts, control logic, and protection schemes.
* Evaluate and finalize key components (cells, racks, PCS, BMS, EMS, transformers, switchgear, HVAC/fire systems).



**Design \& Engineering Management** 



* Prepare detailed design specifications, technical drawings, and engineering deliverables.
* Conduct energy modeling, performance simulations, degradation assessments, and lifecycle analysis.
* Ensure engineering designs meet safety, reliability, and performance standards as per IEC/IEEE/CEA/IS norms.
* Collaborate with civil, electrical, SCADA, and project teams for site integration. Relay Settings and configuration of numerical relays



**Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination** 



* Support vendor evaluation, technology benchmarking, and bid technical assessment.
* Interface with OEMs, EPCs, and consultants for design optimization and technical clarifications.
* Provide engineering inputs during contract negotiation, FATs, and site inspections.
* Liaise with utilities, regulatory bodies, and system operators for grid compliance approvals.



**Project Execution Support** 



* Provide technical oversight during project implementation, commissioning, and performance testing. Engineering of future configuration of BESS like developing a scheme of DC Coupling over the time
* Troubleshoot engineering issues during installation and operation phases.
* Capture lessons learned and update engineering standards and checklists.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering / Power Systems / Energy Systems (or related field).
* 8 \- 10 years of experience in renewable energy, with minimum 5 years in utility\-scale BESS design and engineering.
* Strong knowledge of battery technologies (Li\-ion, LFP, NMC), PCS/EMS systems, and grid interconnection requirements.
* Experience in hybrid project integration (Solar \+ BESS / Wind \+ BESS) is highly desirable.
* Proficiency in electrical design software (AutoCAD, ETAP, PSCAD, PVSyst) and MS Office.
* Familiarity with safety standards (NFPA, NEC, IEC, IEEE) and grid codes.



**Key Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong technical problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent stakeholder coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to work in cross\-functional teams and manage multiple projects.
* Passion for clean energy and innovation.



**Why Join Us** 



* Opportunity to shape the energy storage roadmap of a leading renewable IPP.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge technologies and large\-scale projects.
* Collaborative and growth\-driven work culture.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
 Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Network Engineer.
   

  

 The L1 Senior Network Engineer is responsible for delivering advanced frontline network support, ensuring high availability, performance, and reliability of the enterprise network. This role acts as a senior member within the L1 tier—providing deeper technical troubleshooting, guiding junior engineers, maintaining operational excellence, and ensuring timely incident response and escalation. The engineer supports incidents, service requests, monitoring alerts, and day‑to‑day operational tasks across LAN, WAN, Wi‑Fi, firewall connectivity, and network monitoring systems.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Lead or participate in implementing network security policies across routers and firewalls
* Manage production networks including Internet Protocol backbone, data centers and edge pops across the globe
* Ensure the continuous availability of all data network services
* Identify gaps, risks and issues and navigate organizational structure to resolve them
* Perform quarterly proactive network testing to ensure proper functioning and reliability of the network
* Investigate and remediate network capacity related issues
* Apply knowledge of security and regulatory policies to design and implement foolproof secured network solutions
* Provide resolution information and work with other teams to complete impact analysis
* Deliver comprehensive and maintenance plans for change management review and approval
* Mentor and train network operations team in the installation, configuration, and maintenance
* Partner cross\-functionally with other Product Infrastructure teams in order to continuously improve and apply standards and policies relevant to operational excellence


**Required Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of Network Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.


**Desired Qualifications**
* Incident Management \& Troubleshooting
* Respond to and triage network alerts, connectivity issues, and performance degradations.
* Perform advanced L1/L1\.5 troubleshooting across:
+ LAN/WAN
+ Routers/switches
+ SD‑WAN
+ Wireless (APs/controllers)
+ VPN (IPSec/SSL)
+ DNS/DHCP
+ Basic firewall access issues

* Conduct initial diagnostics and drive issues to resolution or escalate to L2/L3 as needed.
* Document incidents clearly with root\-cause notes, evidence, and resolution steps.
* Operational Support
* Execute approved operational tasks such as:
+ Port activations
+ VLAN assignments
+ Cabling checks
+ Device health validations
+ Basic config reviews under guidance

* Perform daily, weekly, and monthly health checks of network devices and circuits.
* Support scheduled maintenance activities and perform post‑change validations.
* Identify recurring issues and flag them for problem management.
* Monitoring \& Reporting
* Monitor network health and alerts using NMS tools (SolarWinds, PRTG, Cisco Prime, Zabbix, etc.).
* Track WAN link performance, device uptime, interface utilization, and error conditions.
* Prepare daily/weekly reports on incidents, performance trends, and operational KPIs.
* Assist in early detection of issues and proactive mitigation.
* Documentation \& Compliance
* Maintain up‑to‑date network inventory, diagrams, and SOPs.
* Follow ITIL operational standards—Incident, Change, Request, and Problem.
* Update knowledge base articles and provide inputs for continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with security and audit requirements.


**Job Expectations**
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, STP, VPN basics.
* Exposure to Cisco/Juniper/Arista networking platforms.
* Hands\-on experience with:
+ DHCP, DNS
+ NAT
+ OSPF/BGP fundamentals
+ Access lists \& basic firewall troubleshooting

* Experience with network monitoring tools (SolarWinds, PRTG, etc.).
* Familiarity with SD‑WAN technologies (Cisco Viptela, Fortinet, Aruba, etc.) is a plus.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Clear and professional communication with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and guide them through troubleshooting.
* Organized, detail‑oriented, with strong documentation skills.
* Comfortable working in rotating shifts and supporting 24×7 operations.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
* 3–5 years of experience in network operations or support.
* Certifications preferred: CCNA (required)/ CCNP (advantageous)/ ITIL Foundation (preferred)
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Ability to remain calm during major incidents.
* Eagerness to learn and grow into higher engineering roles (L2/L3\).
* Experience in enterprise or global network environments.
* Strengthens frontline operational stability.
* Reduces incident resolution time (MTTR).
* Ensures consistent monitoring and rapid response.
* Supports business continuity by stabilizing connectivity services.
* Acts as a bridge between junior L1 engineers and advanced L2/L3 teams.

**Experience**

**AI \& Automation**

**Technical Foundation**

 ,

**Strategic and Analytical Mindset**

**Working Style \& Mindset** 



* **Agile.** 
 You adapt as fast as products and priorities evolve.

 You balance speed and precision intelligently.

 You spot gaps and fix them.

description:
We are SGS – the world's leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity.
 **Our 99,500 employees operate a network of 2,500 offices and laboratories** 
 , working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking a highly skilled Business Analyst with strong expertise in
 **Oracle E\-Business Suite R12\.2** 
 to support the onboarding of new Legal Entities in countries already live on Oracle EBS. This role focuses on analyzing requirements, ensuring compliance with existing templates, system configuration, and coordinating functional activities across Finance, Tax, and IT teams.
   

  





 The Business Analyst will gather and validate business requirements, confirm localization needs, and ensure alignment with established configuration standards. Responsibilities include the provision of support while actively performing legal entity setup, ledger assignments, and module enablement based on the entity’s operational scope. The role also covers localization setup (tax regimes, statutory reporting, e\-invoicing), data migration planning and validation, and managing deployment to production with full testing and cutover readiness.
   

  





 Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, documentation discipline, and the ability to manage multiple entity onboardings under tight timelines
   

  




* Lead onboarding of new Legal Entities in countries already live on Oracle E\-Business Suite R12\.2
* Assess the existing country operating model (corporate template vs. country\-specific setup) and plan onboarding accordingly
* Configure legal entities, accounting setups, and module\-specific options
* Support localization requirements where applicable (tax, statutory reporting, e\-invoicing)
* Manage data migration activities for master and transactional data
* Coordinate deployment to production and provide hypercare support



 SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES
   

  





 The role encompasses a wide range of responsibilities, including but not limited to the following:
   

  




1. Requirements \& Operating Model Assessment


* Conduct workshops with Finance, Tax, Compliance, and Operations, as needed.
* Identify which model applies in the country, e.g. corporate Chart of Accounts and global template, or country\-specific CoA and localized setup.
* Define onboarding scope and confirm reference entity for alignment.
* Document exceptions and obtain governance approvals.


1. Legal Entity Setup


* Configure Legal Entities using Legal Entity Configurator (LEC) or other tools.
* Associate entities to Operating Units and MOAC security model.
* Validate compliance with reporting and statutory requirements.


1. Ledger \& Accounting Setup


* Assign entities to existing ledgers and accounting setups.
* Handle special cases requiring new ledgers with full impact analysis and approvals.


1. Module Configuration


* Configure modules based on entity scope.
* GL: accounting options, BSVs, reporting hierarchies.
* AP/AR: org\-level options, payment/receipt setups.
* FA, Cash Management, iProcurement, Purchasing, OM, Projects as needed.
* Ensure segregation of duties (SoD) compliance.


1. Localization Setup (Where Applicable)


* Implement country\-specific localization features.
* Tax regimes and rules (EBTax).
* Statutory reporting formats.
* Assess E\-invoicing or compliance integrations.


1. Chart of Accounts \& Security


* Create/extend balancing segment values and maintain hierarchy consistency.
* Update MOAC responsibilities and security profiles.


1. Intercompany


* Onboard entities into custom intercompany solution, where applicable.
* Validate mappings, interfaces, and accounting rules.


1. Data Migration


* Define data migration scope for
	+ master data (suppliers, customers, banks)
	+ transactional data (open invoices, balances).
* Prepare templates, validate data quality, and coordinate load activities.
* Perform reconciliation of migrated data against source systems.


1. Testing \& Deployment


* Prepare SIT/UAT scripts for end\-to\-end flows.
* Support cutover planning, migration sequencing, and go\-live readiness.
* Deploy configurations to production and validate post\-deployment.
* Provide hypercare and ensure successful first close cycle.



  

  





  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* Experienced
 **Oracle EBS R12\.2** 
 Functional Consultant with strong Finance and Enterprise Structure knowledge.
* Able to analyze existing country setup (corporate template vs. localized model) and adapt onboarding approach.
* Comfortable managing multiple entity onboardings under tight timelines.
* Strong communicator and collaborator across Finance, IT, and Compliance teams
* Nice to have: experience with multi\-geo, multi\-currency rollouts and shared services operating models



 REQUIRED SKILLS
   

  




* 5\+ years
 **Oracle EBS R12** 
 .x functional experience (R12\.2 preferred).
* Expertise in:
	+ Legal Entity Configurator (LEC)
	+ Accounting Setup Manager
	+ Multi\-Org concepts and MOAC
* Solid understanding of Oracle Financials modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, CM) and Oracle SCM
* Experience with localization setups (tax, statutory reporting, e\-invoicing).
* Experience with data migration and reconciliation processes.
* Experience with custom intercompany solutions.
* Experience with multi\-county/multi\-entity ERP programs.
* Familiarity with deployment and cutover planning.
* Strong documentation discipline and audit readiness.
* Excellent stakeholder management and problem\-solving skills.

**Purpose of the role**
 To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.

* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.

* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
