title: Manager, Communications & Employer Brand, People Experience - Global Capability Center
description:
Location: Gurugram, India  

Date Posted: Mar 22, 2026

  

**Description**


**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity \- are why our people love working at A\&M.
**The Team**
The Communications Manager supports the Global People Office (GPO) People Experience (PX) team by delivering clear, consistent, and well\-executed communications that strengthen the employee experience and reinforce the firm’s people strategy. This role blends hands\-on execution with coordination, analytics, and continuous improvement across internal, external, and social channels. The Communications Manager partners closely with GPO and cross\-functional stakeholders to manage intake, prioritize requests, and ensure communications are timely, accurate, engaging, and easy to consume.
**How you will contribute**
1\. Communications Execution \& Operations:* Maintain and update core GPO communications trackers, including trackers for campaigns, call discussions, and ongoing initiatives.
* Lead and manage the New Managing Director (MD) email process, ensuring accurate content, timely delivery, appropriate approvals, and alignment with GPO messaging.
* Partner with stakeholders to review incoming requests, confirm scope, and prioritize work based on business needs, timelines, and available capacity.
* Populate and maintain campaign briefs, ensuring objectives, audiences, timelines, governance, and approvals are clearly documented.
* Populate PX presentation slides for Leadership, ensuring consistency in messaging, formatting, and visuals.
* Create agendas and meeting summaries for recurring GPO meetings, capturing key decisions, actions, risks, and follow\-ups.
* Provide flexible support for PX special projects as business priorities evolve.


2\. Creative Channel Management:* Serve as Creative Lead for GPO communications, owning imagery, templates, formats, and banners to ensure visual consistency and alignment with brand standards.
* Manage the Instagram intake process, ensuring all required components are received, drafting copy, selecting photos, and routing content through approvals.
* Schedule approved social media posts and share live links with requestors to help boost engagement and visibility.
* Monitor external platforms (e.g., Glassdoor, Indeed, Fishbowl) for negative, sensitive, or reputationally impactful commentary, escalating themes and insights to appropriate stakeholders.


3\. Analytics, Insights \& Optimization:* Own and maintain the GPO analytics dashboard, tracking performance across channels and campaigns.
* Analyze survey data, engagement metrics, and sentiment signals to identify trends and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Conduct competitor analysis and A\&M sentiment analysis related to the employer brand, summarizing insights and opportunities for improvement.
* Apply learnings from analytics and feedback to continuously refine messaging, formats, and processes.


4\. Technology, Tools \& Process Improvement:* Test, maintain, and support ongoing improvements to the GPO AI tool, ensuring accuracy, usability, and appropriate governance.
* Serve as the point of contact (POC) for GPO creative requests, coordinating inputs, timelines, approvals, and responses.
* Support the build\-out and ongoing refinement of internal and external communications intake and approval processes to improve efficiency, clarity, and consistency.
* Demonstrate adaptability
**Qualifications*** 5\+ years supporting internal, external, and social communications within a corporate, professional services, or HR\-focused environment.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Excellent writing, editing, and content development skills, with strong attention to detail and quality.
* Comfort working with analytics, dashboards, survey data, and performance metrics to inform communications decisions.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive, confidential, or reputationally impactful content.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to provide guidance rather than simply execute requests.
* Awareness of global audiences and cultural considerations when supporting people\-related communications.
* Flexibility and willingness to jump in where needed to support evolving GPO priorities.

**Your journey at A\&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.  


**Inclusive Diversity**
-----------------------


A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who can positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M’s core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are the main reasons our people love working at A\&M. Inclusive Diversity means we embrace diversity, and we foster inclusiveness, encouraging everyone to bring their whole self to work each day. It runs through how we recruit, develop employees, conduct business, support clients, and partner with vendors. It is the A\&M way.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------


It is Alvarez \& Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. .


**Unsolicited Resumes from Third\-Party Recruiters**
----------------------------------------------------


Please note that as per A\&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A\&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

**1\. End\-to\-End HR Operations:**

**2\. Statutory Compliance \& Labor Laws:** 




  




* Take full ownership of all statutory and labor law compliances such as
 **PF, ESI, Professional Tax, CLRA, Shops \& Establishment Act, Gratuity, Bonus, and other applicable regulations**
* Ensure timely filings, returns, and remittances as per legal requirements
* Liaise with government authorities, auditors, and consultants for compliance\-related matters
* Stay updated with changes in labor laws and ensure organizational adherence



  





**3\. Payroll \& HR Administration:** 




  




* Coordinate and validate monthly payroll inputs including attendance, leaves, reimbursements, and deductions
* Ensure payroll accuracy and timely disbursement in coordination with finance or payroll vendors
* Manage attendance systems, leave policies, and employee queries related to compensation

 , including goal setting, mid\-year reviews, and annual appraisals

* Act as a point of contact for employee concerns, grievances, and conflict resolution

* Handle disciplinary actions and ensure proper documentation and compliance



  





**6\. HR Reporting, Audits \& Process Improvements:** 




  




* Prepare and present HR reports and dashboards (headcount, attrition, compliance status, etc.) to management

* Identify gaps in existing HR processes and drive continuous improvement initiatives
* Implement best practices to enhance efficiency, compliance, and employee experience



  





**Desired Candidate Profile:** 




  




* 8–10 years of relevant HR generalist experience with strong operational exposure

* Strong interpersonal, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills

* Experience in handling audits and working with cross\-functional teams

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive **HR cum Admin Executive** to oversee our workforce management and office operations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the full recruitment lifecycle (Labor \& Staff), maintaining statutory compliance and licenses, and ensuring the smooth day\-to\-day administration of the office.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Manpower Management**

* **End\-to\-End Hiring:** Manage recruitment for both office staff (white\-collar) and labor/contract workers (blue\-collar).
* **Onboarding:** Handle documentation, background verification, and orientation for new joiners.
* **Attendance \& Payroll:** Track daily attendance, leave records, and coordinate with accounts for timely salary processing.

**2\. Statutory Compliance \& License Maintenance**

* **License Management:** Timely renewal and maintenance of trade licenses, labor licenses, factory licenses, and fire safety permits.
* **Legal Filings:** Ensure compliance with local labor laws (ESI, PF, Bonus, Gratuity, etc.).
* **Liaison:** Act as the primary point of contact for government officials and labor inspectors.

**3\. Documentation \& File Maintenance**

* **Employee Files:** Maintain physical and digital records for every employee (IDs, contracts, certificates).
* **Admin Records:** Organize and update files related to AMC contracts, utility bills, and office assets.
* **Confidentiality:** Ensure all sensitive company and employee data is stored securely.

**4\. General Administration**

* **Office Upkeep:** Oversee cleaning, repairs, and general maintenance of the premises.
* **Vendor Management:** Handle procurement of office supplies, stationery, and pantry items.
* **Policy Implementation:** Assist in drafting and enforcing office discipline and safety policies.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Experience:** 2–5 years in a dual HR and Admin role (Experience in manufacturing or labor\-intensive industries is a plus).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **Knowledge:** Deep understanding of **Local Labor Laws** and statutory compliance.
* **Tech Savvy:** Proficient in MS Office (especially Excel) and HRMS software.

**Job Title**

**Talent Acquisition Executive / Senior Talent Acquisition Executive**

**Company**

**House of EdTech (Goenka Kachave LLP)**

**Location**

Kolkata, Work from Office

**Employment Type**

Full\-time

**Experience**

1–2 years in Talent Acquisition or a similar role

**Compensation**

₹1\.80–3\.60 LPA (Based on experience and expertise)

**Education**

Graduate (B.Tech, B.Com, BBA, BA, etc.), MBA preferred

**About House of EdTech**

**House of EdTech (Goenka Kachave LLP)** is a high\-growth, multi\-entity EdTech organization focused on delivering **large\-scale, outcome\-driven professional education** across high\-impact domains including **Artificial Intelligence, Finance, Data, Product Management, and Business Skills**.

Founded by **Aditya Goenka \- Founder @ Be10x \& Office Master \| Enabling People Upskill Themselves \| LinkedIn)** and **Aditya Kachave \- Be10x \| LinkedIn),** **IIT Kharagpur alumni**, the organization has rapidly emerged as one of India’s most dynamic EdTech groups by combining **cutting\-edge curriculum, practitioner\-led training, and performance\-driven execution**. With a strong learner\-first philosophy and deep expertise in digital education delivery, House of EdTech enables working professionals and entrepreneurs to **upskill, increase productivity, and unlock measurable career and income growth**.

Today, the organization:

* **Serves over 5 million learners** across India and global markets
* Operates at an **annual recurring revenue (ARR) exceeding ₹350 crore**
* Employs **1,000\+ professionals** across sales, marketing, tech, product, and operations
* Maintains a **strong on\-ground presence in Pune and Kolkata**, supported by pan\-India digital reach

**Diversified Brand Portfolio**

House of EdTech operates a **strategically diversified portfolio of category\-leading education brands**, each addressing distinct learner needs and professional outcomes:

* **Be10x** ()Focused on practical AI tools and productivity solutions that help professionals work smarter and faster using real\-world AI applications.
* **Office Master** ()Specializes in advanced MS Excel, Power BI, and Office productivity programs designed for business and data professionals.
* **AI for Techies** ()Caters to technical professionals seeking hands\-on AI, Python, and SQL skills for accelerated career growth in tech and analytics roles.
* **Dr. Finance** ()Delivers structured personal finance education, enabling individuals to make informed decisions around saving, investing, and wealth creation.
* **Profit Uni** ()Provides applied stock market and trading education, focusing on practical strategies, risk management, and consistent profitability.
* **Springpad** ()Offers specialized programs in analytics and business intelligence, empowering learners with job\-ready, insight\-driven skills.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic **Talent Acquisition Executive / Senior Talent Acquisition Executive** to join our HR team in Kolkata. In this role, you will be responsible for end\-to\-end recruitment, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination and offer management. This is an excellent opportunity for someone passionate about talent acquisition to work in a high\-growth EdTech environment and contribute to building world\-class teams.

**Key ResponsibilitiesTalent Sourcing \& Strategy**

* Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies to attract top candidates
* Utilize multiple channels such as job portals, social media, LinkedIn, referrals, and professional networks to source candidates
* Identify new and creative ways to reach out to potential candidates
* Research and implement innovative recruiting techniques
* Leverage employer branding to attract quality talent
* Create compelling job postings and recruitment advertisements

**Candidate Screening \& Shortlisting**

* Review resumes and applications to identify the best talent
* Conduct initial screening calls to evaluate candidates' skills, experience, and culture fit
* Assess candidate qualifications against job requirements
* Maintain timely and professional communication with all applicants
* Shortlist candidates efficiently to move them through the hiring funnel
* Evaluate both technical skills and cultural alignment

**Interview Coordination \& Process Management**

* Schedule interviews and coordinate between candidates and hiring managers
* Manage end\-to\-end interview logistics and communications
* Gather and document interview feedback to facilitate smooth decision\-making
* Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process
* Track candidate progress through recruitment stages
* Follow up with candidates and provide timely updates

**Building \& Maintaining Talent Pipelines**

* Proactively build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for future hiring needs
* Engage with passive candidates and develop long\-term relationships with potential hires
* Create talent pools segmented by role, skills, and experience level
* Keep track of industry hiring trends and market conditions
* Nurture candidate relationships for future opportunities
* Stay updated on salary benchmarks and competitive landscape

**Employer Branding \& Candidate Experience**

* Represent the company in a professional and engaging manner
* Actively contribute to enhancing the employer brand by ensuring a positive candidate experience
* Promote House of EdTech as a great place to work through social media, networking events, and recruitment campaigns
* Showcase company culture and values to attract the right talent
* Gather candidate feedback to improve recruitment experience
* Participate in job fairs, campus placements, and networking events

**Recruitment Analytics \& Reporting**

* Maintain accurate recruitment data and generate reports on key hiring metrics
* Use data\-driven insights to optimize recruitment strategies and improve hiring efficiency
* Track metrics such as time\-to\-hire, cost\-per\-hire, source effectiveness, and conversion rates
* Provide regular updates to leadership on recruitment status
* Utilize Applicant Tracking System (ATS) effectively
* Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

**Required Skills \& QualificationsMust\-Have Skills \& Experience**

* **Experience** – 1–2 years in Talent Acquisition or a similar HR role
* **Recruitment Knowledge** – Strong knowledge of recruitment processes, sourcing strategies, and hiring best practices
* **Communication** – Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* **Multitasking** – Ability to manage multiple job openings and prioritize tasks effectively
* **Technical Proficiency** – Proficiency in using job portals, LinkedIn, and applicant tracking systems (ATS)
* **Interpersonal Skills** – Strong interpersonal skills to engage with candidates and stakeholders effectively

**Core Competencies**

* **Sourcing Excellence** – Creative and effective in finding and attracting talent
* **Candidate Assessment** – Strong interviewing and evaluation skills
* **Relationship Building** – Ability to build rapport with candidates and hiring managers
* **Organization** – Excellent organizational and time management skills
* **Adaptability** – Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* **Attention to Detail** – Meticulous in candidate screening and documentation
* **Proactive Approach** – Self\-starter who takes initiative

**Preferred Qualifications (Good to Have)**

* Experience working in the EdTech industry or fast\-growing startups
* Knowledge of HR software and recruitment tools
* Experience in campus hiring, bulk hiring, or leadership hiring
* Exposure to technical recruitment
* Understanding of compensation benchmarking
* Certification in HR or recruitment (SHRM, HRCI, etc.)
* Experience with employer branding initiatives

**What We OfferCareer Growth \& Development**

* **Career Growth** – We invest in your development through mentorship programs, training sessions, and career advancement opportunities
* **Skill Enhancement** – Learn advanced recruitment techniques and talent strategies
* **Clear Progression** – Path to senior TA roles and HR leadership positions
* **Learning Opportunities** – Exposure to diverse roles and hiring across multiple functions

**Work Culture \& Environment**

* **Work Culture** – A supportive, energetic, and collaborative work environment where your ideas are valued
* **Dynamic Team** – Work with 1,000\+ passionate professionals across the organization
* **Modern Office** – Well\-equipped office in Kolkata with professional amenities
* **Inclusive Environment** – Diverse and inclusive workplace culture

**Brand Exposure \& Impact**

* **Diverse Portfolio** – Work with leading brands such as:
* Springpad
* Be10x
* Profit Uni
* Office Master
* Mad About Sports
* Dr. Finance
* AI for Techies
* **Business Impact** – Play a key role in building teams that serve 5 million\+ learners
* **Mission\-Driven** – Contribute to democratizing education by hiring the best talent

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* **Competitive Compensation \& Benefits** – Attractive salary (₹1\.80–3\.60 LPA), performance incentives, and employee perks
* **Performance Recognition** – Rewards for successful hiring and contributions
* **Growth Potential** – Clear salary progression based on performance

**Additional Benefits**

* Opportunity to shape talent acquisition processes and strategies
* Professional network building in EdTech and HR community
* Exposure to recruitment across sales, tech, content, operations, and more
* Structured onboarding and training program
* Recognition as a key contributor to organizational growth

**Why Join House of EdTech?**

At House of EdTech (Goenka Kachave LLP), we are on a mission to empower learners and professionals through innovative educational solutions. Join our team of dynamic employees and be part of a company that values growth, learning, and innovation.

We're not just hiring recruiters—we're building a talent acquisition function that will support our ambitious growth plans and help us reach millions more learners across India and beyond.

**Ready to grow your career in Talent Acquisition?**

Apply now and be a part of our success story! Join us in building the teams that are transforming professional education in India.

**Please submit:**

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
Core Roles \& Responsibilities1\. CAD Modeling and Drafting

This is the "bread and butter" of a junior designer. You will spend a significant portion of your time creating digital blueprints.

* **3D Modeling:** Developing detailed 3D parts and assemblies using software like SolidWorks, CATIA, or Creo.
* **2D Technical Drawings:** Converting 3D models into 2D shop drawings with proper views, sections, and annotations.
* **GD\&T Application:** Applying **Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing** to ensure parts fit together correctly during assembly.

2\. Design Documentation \& Management

Engineering is as much about the "paper trail" as it is about the hardware.

* **BOM Creation:** Maintaining the **Bill of Materials** (BOM), ensuring every nut, bolt, and custom part is accounted for.
* **Engineering Change Notices (ECN):** Documenting modifications made to existing designs to improve performance or reduce costs.
* **Technical Reports:** Assisting in writing manuals or assembly instructions for the manufacturing floor.

3\. Analysis and Validation

Before a part is made, you have to prove it won't fail.

* **FEA Support:** Performing basic **Finite Element Analysis** to check for stress points or deformations under load.
* **Tolerance Stack\-up:** Calculating how small variations in part sizes might affect the final assembly.
* **Prototyping:** Working with 3D printers or CNC shops to create physical samples for testing.

4\. Collaboration and Manufacturing Support

You act as the bridge between an idea and a physical object.

* **DFM/DFA:** Learning to design for **Manufacturability and Assembly**, ensuring parts aren't unnecessarily difficult or expensive to build.
* **Vendor Coordination:** Communicating with suppliers to source standard components (like bearings or motors) and checking their specifications.
* **Cross\-functional Meetings:** Sitting in on design reviews with senior engineers to learn how to defend your design choices.

* Stay updated with industry standards such as ATA100, iSpec2200, S1000D, and ASD\-STE100\.


**Your Profile**
* Experience: 2–8 years in AMM authoring, preferably within Airbus programs.

+ Strong understanding of Airframe and Systems ATA chapters.
+ Proficient in interpreting engineering drawings and specifications.

* Tool Knowledge: Hands\-on experience with Airbus documentation tools (GIPSY, GIDOCA, SAP, ZAMIZ, DACAS, PDMLink).

Welcome to Associative! We are a 5\-year\-old software development firm headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra, established on February 1, 2021\. We are a team of dedicated innovators and IT professionals passionate about transforming visionary ideas into scalable digital realities.

We are currently seeking a passionate and talented **Unreal Engine Game Developer** to join our growing Game Development, AR, \& VR team.

Qualifications \& Requirements

* **Experience:** Fresher
* **Education:** Any Graduate
* **Must Have:** Own Laptop for work
* **Languages:** Hindi, English, and Marathi

What We Offer

* **Employment Type:** Full\-time, Permanent
* **Work Location:** Onsite at our Pune office
* **Office Hours:** 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM
* **Work Schedule:** Monday through Saturday

Important Information \& Hiring Process

To ensure clarity and manage expectations, please review the following key points regarding this position:

* **Eligibility:** This position is **not** intended for candidates who are currently pursuing their education or any full\-time courses. We are strictly seeking candidates ready to join a full\-time role.
* **Work Model:** This is a full\-time, in\-office position at our Pune location. We do **not** offer remote work, work\-from\-home, or part\-time arrangements.
* **Interview Format:** This is a mandatory **in\-person interview**. Virtual or online interviews are not available for any role.
* **Direct Hiring:** We are hiring directly for our own team. We are not an outsourcing agency or a recruitment consultancy.
* **No Fees:** We do not charge any fees for recruitment, interviews, or training. Please do not pay any individual or third party for any part of this hiring process.

About Associative

Associative is formally registered with the Registrar of Firms (ROF), Pune, and operates with unyielding transparency. We hold official accreditations as an Adobe Silver Solution Partner, Adobe Certified Reseller, and Official Reseller Partner of Strapi.

Our Game Development, AR \& VR division creates immersive worlds and interactive simulations utilizing engines like Unreal Engine 5, Unity, Godot, and CryEngine. We are also at the forefront of R\&D with our flagship project, *NexusReal: Intelligence Fused Reality*, bridging digital intelligence and physical reality using AI avatars, NeRFs, and Gaussian Splatting.

Contact Us

We look forward to bringing your vision to life.

* **Address:** Khandve Complex, Yojana Nagar, Lohegaon \- Wagholi Road, Lohegaon, Pune, Maharashtra, India – 411047
* **Find us on Google:** Search "Associative Pune"

title: Sales Manager on commission basis
description:
In Siliguri, you have to sell a useful electrical product by visiting people's houses daily.

You have to approach and pitch the product, explain, track records, and make sales.

There will be no target and no salary, only on a commission basis.

If you sell 1 product, you will get 500 rupees, so if you sell 2 products daily, you will make 1000 daily, and in a month, it will be 30,000\.

Selling our product is very easy, if you visit 10 houses daily, you will definitely make 2 sales.

If you can visit more and work more with enthusiasm, then you will definitely make more than 2 sales, and that will increase your monthly income, which will increase by 35k to 45k or more.

Skills Needed:

1\. Good communication skills

2\. Door to door sales experience

3\. Highly motivated and always happy person

4\. Very patient and result oriented person

title: Product Design Intern
description:
**Position Overview**:  
As a **Product Design Intern**, you will assist the design team in creating engaging and intuitive product designs. You will work on real\-world projects, participate in design discussions, and contribute your creative ideas to help improve user experience and product functionality.

**Key Responsibilities**:

* **Collaborate with the Design Team**: Work closely with product designers and engineers to create design concepts and prototypes for new products and features.
* **Wireframing \& Prototyping**: Assist in creating wireframes, mockups, and prototypes for product interfaces, ensuring a seamless user experience.
* **User Research**: Help conduct user research, including surveys, interviews, and usability testing, to gather insights and apply findings to design solutions.
* **Visual Design**: Develop high\-quality visual designs and assets, including icons, illustrations, and UI components.
* **Feedback and Iteration**: Participate in design critiques, provide feedback, and iterate on designs based on team input and user testing results.
* **Design Documentation**: Help maintain design documentation, including style guides, user flows, and design specifications, to ensure consistency across products.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**: Work alongside product managers, engineers, and marketing teams to ensure design vision aligns with product goals and brand identity.

**Requirements**:

* **Education**: Currently pursuing or recently graduated with a degree in Product Design, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, or a related field.
* **Skills**:
* Proficiency in design tools like Adobe XD, Sketch, Figma, or similar.
* Strong understanding of design principles, user\-centered design, and visual hierarchy.
* Experience or familiarity with prototyping and wireframing tools.
* **Portfolio**: A portfolio showcasing your design work, including any relevant projects or internships.
* **Team Player**: Ability to collaborate effectively with different teams and adapt to changing requirements.
* **Communication**: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* **Curiosity and Passion**: A keen interest in product design, user experience, and innovation.

**What We Offer**:

* **Hands\-On Experience**: Opportunity to work on live projects that have real\-world impact.
* **Mentorship**: Receive guidance and feedback from senior designers and cross\-functional teams.
* **Networking**: Build connections with professionals in the product design and tech industry.
* **Paid Internship**: Competitive compensation for the duration of the internship.
* **Flexible Work Environment**: Depending on the role, the internship can be remote or hybrid.

title: Sales Excecutive
description:
**AV Core** is a global audiovisual consulting and solutions company with operations across international markets, including the UAE and the Middle East, Europe, and Africa. The company specializes in **end\-to\-end AV solutions**—from design and engineering to supply, integration, and commissioning of high\-end audiovisual environments.

Our projects include **corporate AV systems, experience centers, control rooms, and premium home theatres for HNIs**.

**Role Overview**

We are hiring Sales Executives in Mumbai and Vadodara to drive business for **high\-value, turnkey AV projects**.

This is a **consultative B2B \+ B2C hybrid sales role**, requiring strong relationship\-building skills, patience for long sales cycles (3–6 months), and the ability to close high\-ticket deals.

**Key Responsibilities** 

**1\. Business Development**

Identify and generate new business opportunities across:

* Command Centers
* Architects \& interior designers
* Corporate clients \& offices
* Government Projects
* Law Enforcement Departments
* Real estate developers
* HNI clients (home theatres \& smart AV setups)
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified leads

**2\. Relationship Building**

* Develop long\-term relationships with:
* Design firms and consultants
* Project managers and contractors
* Become a trusted AV partner in early project stages
* Research and Fulfil Tenders requirements

**3\. Consultative Selling**

* Understand client needs and propose tailored AV solutions
* Work closely with internal technical teams for:
* System design
* BOQs and proposals
* Present solutions in a clear, high\-confidence manner

**4\. Sales Closure**

* Manage the full sales cycle:
* Lead → Meeting → Proposal → Negotiation → Closure
* Handle commercial discussions and deal structuring
* Consistently achieve revenue targets

**5\. Market Development**

* Build AV Core’s brand presence in Mumbai/Vadodara markets
* Track industry trends and competitor activity
* Represent the company in meetings, site visits, and industry forums

**Candidate Profile: Experience \- 1–3 Years**

* Strong drive for business development
* Comfortable with cold outreach and fieldwork
* Hungry to grow in high\-value B2B sales
* Proven experience in B2B / project sales
* Comfortable handling long sales cycles
* Experience dealing with architects, corporates, or HNIs preferred

**Industry Background**

* AV / Home Automation / ELV / Smart Systems
* Interior design / architecture ecosystem
* Corporate or enterprise solutions sales

**Skills Required**

* Strong communication and presentation skills
* High ownership and self\-driven attitude
* Ability to handle long and complex sales cycles
* Negotiation and commercial understanding
* Relationship\-first selling mindset

**Technical Knowledge**

* Prior AV knowledge is a plus, but **not mandatory**
* Candidate must be willing to learn technical aspects quickly

**Compensation Structure**

* Fixed salary (based on experience)
* Performance\-linked incentives (closure\-based)
* Opportunity for **high earnings on large\-ticket deals**

**Location**

* Mumbai / Vadodara (field\-intensive role with travel)

**What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)**

* Build a strong pipeline across architects, corporates, and HNIs
* Establish at least 15–25 active client relationships
* Close initial projects
* Demonstrate consistent lead generation and follow\-ups

**Why Join AV Core**

* Work with an **international brand** in a niche, high\-growth segment
* Strong Vendor Relationships
* Exposure to **premium, large\-scale AV projects**
* Opportunity to grow into **business head / regional lead roles**
* High learning curve in a specialized industry

**Important Reality Check (included intentionally)**

This role is **not for short\-term or transactional salespeople**.

* Sales cycles are long (3–6 months)
* Deals require patience, follow\-up, and relationship depth
* High rewards come with persistence and consistency

Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.

title: Senior Manager HR
description:
**Senior Manager HR, HR Business Partner,** 




  





 Join a PE\-backed B2B software business in the fraud prevention and digital risk space, hiring its senior HR leader for India as the region scales rapidly.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on HRBP role supporting high\-performing engineering and product teams, with real ownership, senior stakeholder exposure, and the chance to shape how the India organisation grows. If you enjoy partnering with technical leaders, tightening operating discipline, and building strong people foundations in a fast\-paced environment, this one is worth a look.
 



  





**Company snapshot** 




 A global enterprise software company operating in fraud prevention and authentication for banking and payments. Profitable, well\-backed, and investing heavily in product innovation and growth. International footprint, remote\-first ways of working, and a leadership team that expects high standards and clear execution.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 India is the fastest\-growing region and the current HR setup is not scaling with hiring volume and leadership needs.
 



  





 The business needs a more senior HRBP who can influence engineering leaders, bring structure to recruitment and talent practices, and improve consistency across the employee lifecycle.
 



  





 This is a newly created role, designed to add strategic depth and day to day execution power in\-region.
 



  





**About the role** 




 You will be the senior HR partner for India, supporting circa 120 FTEs today and growing, largely across technology and product innovation teams.
 



  





 You will lead end\-to\-end HR delivery, while also building leadership capability, improving hiring discipline, and strengthening the employee experience.
 



  





 You will manage and develop a regional HR Generalist/Recruiter, and partner closely with global HR leadership.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Partner with India and global leaders on org design, workforce planning, leadership coaching, and talent strategy
* Drive performance management, talent reviews, development planning, and succession conversations
* Lead employee relations and complex advisory cases with strong judgement and consistency
* Bring structure to recruitment, including intake discipline, hiring manager alignment, and process adherence
* Coach leaders on effective people management, feedback, and decision\-making
* Improve HR operations in\-region, including data accuracy, policy application, and programme delivery
* Use HR metrics to identify trends in attrition, engagement, and workforce planning, then act on them
* Lead engagement and culture initiatives locally, working closely with global programmes
* Develop and upskill the regional HR team member, raising quality, pace, and consistency



  





**Ideal candidate profile** 



* Strong HRBP or HR leadership experience in India, ideally supporting technology, product, or engineering organisations
* Credibility and confidence partnering with senior technical leaders, able to influence and challenge when needed
* Proven strength in recruitment leadership and process design, particularly for technical hiring
* Prior people management experience, not a first\-time manager
* Solid grounding in India employment law and hands\-on employee relations
* Comfortable operating in a global environment, communicating clearly with international stakeholders
* Practical, sleeves\-rolled\-up approach, you can diagnose problems and fix them, not just advise



  





**Location and working style** 



* India\-based role, with Bangalore preferred due to stakeholder proximity
* Open to other India locations if you can travel into Bangalore regularly
* Remote\-first environment, you need to be effective without relying on a traditional office setup
* Regional travel expected, details to be confirmed during process



  





**Why join** 



* High impact seat, owning the people agenda for the company’s fastest\-growing region
* Direct exposure to global HR leadership and senior engineering stakeholders
* Genuine opportunity to improve hiring quality and operating discipline, not just run BAU HR
* Broad remit across HRBP, talent, performance, ER, culture, and analytics
* Strong runway for expanded international scope over time as coverage needs evolve
* A role suited to someone who wants ownership, visibility, and the chance to build

title: Quality Control - DET
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Diploma Trainee Engineer – Quality Control supports quality assurance activities by assisting in inspection, testing, and documentation of manufactured components. This role provides hands\-on training in quality control processes, measurement techniques, and compliance with applicable standards under the supervision of experienced quality engineers.
   

  

**Work You’ll Do**
* Assist in inspection and measurement of components using basic quality tools and instruments.
* Support incoming, in\-process, and final inspection activities as per quality plans.
* Help identify non\-conformities and report deviations to senior quality engineers.
* Assist in maintaining inspection records, reports, and quality documentation.
* Support implementation of quality procedures, work instructions, and SOPs.
* Follow safety, quality, and housekeeping standards on the shop floor.


**Team**
 This role will be part of the Quality Assurance and Control team within the manufacturing facility, working closely with production, engineering, and senior quality personnel to ensure products meet defined quality standards.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Diploma in Mechanical / Production / Industrial Engineering or related discipline.
* Fresher or up to 1 year of industrial training or quality\-related experience.
* Basic understanding of engineering drawings and measurement concepts.
* Familiarity with measuring instruments such as vernier calipers and micrometers.
* Willingness to learn quality processes and work in a manufacturing environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to quality control practices through internship or apprenticeship.
* Basic knowledge of quality standards such as ISO 9001\.
* Awareness of shop\-floor inspection and manufacturing processes.
* Good communication skills and attention to detail.


**Who We Are**
 Milacron is a global leader in the manufacture, distribution and service of highly engineered and customized systems within the $27 billion plastic technology and processing industry. We are the only global company with a full\-line product portfolio that includes hot runner systems, injection molding, extrusion equipment. We maintain strong market positions across these products, as well as leading positions in process control systems, mold bases and components, maintenance, repair and operating (“MRO”) supplies for plastic processing equipment. Our strategy is to deliver highly customized equipment, components and service to our customers throughout the lifecycle of their plastic processing technology systems.
   

  

**Eeo**
 The policy of Milacron is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. We are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offer opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us at recruitingaccommodations@milacron.com. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

* Proficiency with SonicWall CSE and Cisco VPN
* Experience leveraging Cloudflare Advanced DDoS for web security and performance
* Demonstrable skill with network monitoring tools, specifically SolarWinds
* Deep understanding of core networking protocols and concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VPNs, VLANs)

* Security Tools: Experience with vulnerability management (Tanium) or endpoint security (Rapid7\)
* Systems Background: A foundation in System Administration (Linux/Windows Server)

* Certifications: Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, cloud networking certs)
* Scripting: Ability to automate tasks using Python or PowerShell


**What We Offer**
* Competitive salary and bonus,
* Comprehensive Group health insurance,
* PF match by Company
* Generous PTO, flexible work schedule

**Job Description: Postsale Billing \& Calculations Product Owner / business analyst** 




  





**Role Summary** 




 The Postsale Billing \& Calculations Product Owner / business analyst is responsible for end‑to‑end ownership of Postsale calculation, billing, invoicing, and balancing capabilities .This role serves as the primary liaison between Business, IT, QA, and external stakeholders, ensuring system accuracy, regulatory compliance, operational stability, and successful delivery of enhancements and releases.
 



 The role owns backlog prioritization, testing strategy, month‑end processes, compliance controls, and production issue resolution, with a strong emphasis on automation, system‑driven corrections.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Product Ownership \& Backlog Management** 



* Own and manage the Postsale product backlog .
* Drive backlog grooming, prioritization, and roadmap planning in partnership with Business, Billing, IT, and QA.
* Ensure backlog items are well‑defined with clear scope, acceptance criteria, and traceability.
* Evaluate feasibility and prioritization of enhancements not currently in backlog, including:
* TREO and My Accounts integration
* Life Sciences and Loss Sensitive strategies
* New calculation schedules (e.g., Annual Prefunded Reassessment)
* Program Period‑level invoicing
* WC Loss Sensitive and General Liability initiatives
* Cloud migration–related impacts



  





**Testing Strategy \& Release Readiness** 



* Define and oversee test strategy and test data identification for:
* PBP and Table Maintenance (TM) components
* Non‑PBP/TM modules (LBP, calculations, jobs, month‑end runs)
* End‑to‑end testing
* Coordinate with Business and QA teams on:
* Test account creation (Presale / PC)
* Claims and policy data setup
* UAT planning and validation
* Manage QA region strategy, including refreshes and isolation of testing (QA / QA2\).
* Review and approve test plans, rule mining outputs, mockups, and QA documentation.



  





**Month‑End Calculations, Invoicing \& Balancing** 



* Own governance and oversight of month‑end calculation and invoicing batches.
* Coordinate and approve balancing activities, including:
* Out‑of‑balance approvals
* CCPS, NADB, and claims reconciliation
* TPA Payable calculations and invoicing
* Ensure predictive and month‑end reports are reviewed and validated prior to close.
* Partner with Billing, Actuarial, and IT teams to resolve discrepancies and improve runtime efficiency.
* Drive system‑based corrections over manual adjustments whenever feasible.



  





**Operational Support \& Incident Management** 



* Serve as escalation point for complex production issues and long‑running defects.
* Guide resolution strategies for PACER adjustments, imbalances, and calculation discrepancies.
* Ensure effective communication to stakeholders during incidents, including turnaround expectations.
* Reduce ticket volume by addressing knowledge gaps through documentation, KT sessions, and weekly forums.



  





**Compliance, SOX \& Regulatory Oversight** 



* Ensure compliance with Internal SOX controls, external regulatory requirements, and application security standards.
* Oversee:
* CCPS external reconciliation and evidence retention
* User access reviews and PROD access approvals
* Admin and IT screen access controls
* Coordinate responses to state regulatory audits and retro premium calculation reviews.
* Drive automation initiatives (e.g., NCM reconciliation) to strengthen control posture.



  





**Data Integrity \& Governance** 



* Establish guidelines for external balancing and approval of small dollar / small claim differences.
* Protect data dependencies across systems (e.g., NADB impacts on purge strategies).
* Coordinate with IT on cloud migration concerns, risks, and mitigation strategies.
* Ensure accurate data feeds and integrations across PC, CCPS, Claims, PACER, and NADB.



  





**Cross‑Team Collaboration \& Communication** 



* Act as primary point of coordination across:
* Business \& Billing teams
* IT \& Architecture
* QA \& Release Management
* PACER, PDA, and external vendor


- 


**Branding \& Invoice Modernization** 



* Partner with PDA and PACER teams on invoice branding initiatives, including:
* Company name updates
* Banner, color, and template changes
* Risk‑specific invoice templates
* Ensure successful rollout and validation of updated invoice templates.

* Strong expertise in:
* Billing, invoicing, and financial calculations

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Job Title:** 
**Business Analyst**
**Department** 
 : CIB
 **GM IT**
**About Business Line/Function**
 The Global Markets (GM) business of BNP Paribas helps its Corporate and Institutional clients leverage capital markets across the globe for their financing, risk management and investment needs. This encompasses a wide range of financial products ranging from foreign exchange to complex Equity Derivatives that are traded in financial markets across the globe 24/7\.
   

  

 IT systems are integral to the business and are a key part of the value proposition to clients. These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications.
   

  

 The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis \& Project Management, Development \& Maintenance and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions is an equal partner in these IT functions along with colleagues in other locations including Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore \& Hong Kong. This partnership ranges from sharing the IT workload, executing global strategy to owning global applications offshore. The technology and engineering landscape is wide, encompassing almost all techniques and platforms. It continues to evolve and transform with the market with the business continuing to invest in it.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
**The Lead Business Analyst, Global Market OTC Derivative will be a key contributor to the firm’s strategic initiatives, acting as a liaison between front\-office trades, operations, risk management, and technology teams. This role requires a deep, end\-to\-end understanding of the OTC derivatives trade lifecycle, from execution and trade capture to settlement, valuation, and regulatory reporting. The successful candidate will lead the analysis and delivery of complex IT solutions and process improvements that support and enhance the global OTC trading desk.**
**These applications are manned by a team of Business Analysts, Developers and Testers, spread across London, Paris, Singapore and India, with program management in London. The team is made of very senior technicians and analysts globally, who create tools and support the functional application teams by being leaders on matters of technology.**
**Agile Scrum methodology has followed as SDLC. The position will be working as a part of the scrum taking on roles of Business analyst or Scrum master as required.**
**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* Strategic Project Leadership: Lead and manage complex project for OTC derivative business initiatives from ideation to delivery, working in an Agile.
* Business Requirement Analysis: Elicit, analyse, and document complex business requirements from global stakeholders, creating functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Stakeholder Management: Act as a primary point of contact for senior\-level stakeholder across trading, risk, operations, and IT to ensure alignment and drive consensus on business needs and strategic direction.
* Expert Analysis and Solution Design: Perform in\-depth analysis to identify business gaps, optimize front\-to\-back processes, and design effective system and process solutions that mitigate risk and increase operational efficiency.
* Trade Lifecycle Management: Utilize extensive knowledge of the OTC trade lifecycle, including trade booking, confirmation, clearing, settlement, collateral management, and other post\-trade events.
* Regulatory Compliance: Translate complex global regulatory requirement (e.g. EMIR, DF, MiFID, KRX and so on) into functional system requirement and implement solution that ensure compliance.
* Quality Assurance and Testing: Oversee and participate in the creation and execution of detailed test cases and user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate that solution meet business requirements.
* Mentorship and Coaching: Guide and mentor team members on derivative products and best practices for system analysis and delivery.


**Continuous Improvement:** 
 Proactively monitor market trends, technology, and industry best practices to recommend and implement process and system enhancements.
   

  

 Contributing Responsibilities
   

  

* Team player.
* Effectively communicate with stakeholders.
* Adhere to timelines set for delivery.
* Open to new technology adaptions, learning and implementation within the project.
* Maintain the team practices and processes, retrospectives.
* Status reporting to technical and functional managers.


 Technical \& Behavioral Competencies
   

  

* Working experience in Financial Markets \& Trading Platforms (OTC derivative products predominantly Interest Rate Derivatives), Trade Life Cycle and familiarity with underlying data.
* Understanding of Front Office/Middle Office/ Back\-office functions.
* Strong analytical and investigative skills \- Understand and efficiently analyze information/requirements from multiple sources.
* Demonstrated leadership ability in project management, team coordination, and driving strategic change.
* Experience in writing BRDs and FSDs.
* Very Good knowledge of RDBMS / SQL.
* Possess the ability to explain and articulate solutions and work constructively with others including more senior and junior members in the team to implement the same.
* Good to have experience of IBM MQ.
* Demonstrate the ability to show initiative and take the lead solving business focused analytics problems.
* Have a “can do” attitude that focuses on resolving the overall problem in the medium and long term as well as meeting the short\-term objectives.


**Willingness and ability to put effort even when not explicitly requested to do so.**
**Specific Qualifications**
* 12 to 15 years of experience as a Business Analyst in capital markets, with extensive hands\-on experience in OTC derivative.
* Deep knowledge of OTC derivative products across multiple asset classes, including LMB, equity, rates, and credit derivatives.
* Significant experience with core OTC derivative systems and platforms (e.g. Calypso, Murex, vendor systems) and tools for confirmation (e.g. Markitwire, DTCC).
* Strong IRD knowledge.


**Technical Skills**

 Mumbai.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

GFS Governance* Issue monthly GFS dashboards with root\-cause analysis and leadership\-level summaries.

description:
Job Description: Hotel Manager

Position OverviewWe are looking for an experienced, dynamic Hotel Manager to lead the overall operations of our \[3\-5 star / boutique / luxury] hotel. As the key leader on property, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional guest experiences, driving operational efficiency, maximizing revenue, and building a high\-performing team. This is a hands\-on leadership role that demands strong business acumen, people skills, and a passion for hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee all hotel departments (Front Office, Housekeeping, Food \& Beverage, Sales, Maintenance, Finance, and HR) and ensure seamless day\-to\-day operations.
* Lead, motivate, and develop a team of 50–150\+ associates; conduct performance reviews, training programs, and succession planning.
* Deliver outstanding guest satisfaction scores (TripAdvisor, Google, internal surveys) and personally resolve escalated guest issues.
* Drive revenue through dynamic pricing, upselling strategies, corporate contracts, events, and banquet sales in coordination with the Sales \& Revenue team.
* Manage operating budgets, control costs (payroll, supplies, utilities), and achieve or exceed monthly and annual financial targets (RevPAR, GOP, ADR).
* Maintain the highest standards of cleanliness, safety, security, and compliance with local health, fire, and licensing regulations.
* Develop and execute annual marketing and business plans in collaboration with ownership or corporate office.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, travel agents, OTA partners, and local community stakeholders.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and guest feedback to recommend service and product improvements.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly management reports for ownership/corporate leadership.

Requirements \& QualificationsEducation

* Bachelor’s degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or equivalent (Master’s preferred).

Experience

* Minimum 5–8 years of progressive hotel experience with at least 2–3 years as Hotel Manager or Assistant General Manager in a 50\+ room property.
* Proven track record in revenue management, cost control, and team leadership.

Skills \& Competencies

* Strong leadership and people\-management skills with ability to inspire teams.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills (fluency in English \+ local language required).
* Proficient in Opera / Fidelio, PMS, POS systems, and Microsoft Office (especially Excel).
* Solid understanding of financial statements (P\&L, budgets, forecasting).
* High emotional intelligence and crisis\-management ability.
* Guest\-obsessed mindset with a hands\-on “roll\-up\-the\-sleeves” attitude.

Preferred

* Experience with international hotel brands (IHG, Marriott, Hilton, Accor, etc.).
* Certification in revenue management, food safety, or hospitality leadership programs.
* Working knowledge of labor laws and union environments (if applicable).

What We Offer

* Competitive salary \+ performance bonus (up to 20–30% of annual CTC).
* Comprehensive benefits package (health insurance, accommodation/meals, transport, gratuity).
* Career growth opportunities within the group.
* Free meals while on duty and uniform.
* Dynamic work environment in a fast\-growing hospitality company.

Reporting LineReports directly to: Owner / Regional Director / Area General Manager

If you are a results\-driven hospitality professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and loves creating memorable guest experiences, we want to hear from you!

How to ApplyPlease send your updated resume and current salary details to \[email] with the subject line: “Hotel Manager Application – \[Your Name]”.

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity.*

description:
Mechanical engineers are versatile professionals who research, design, develop, build, and test mechanical and thermal systems, ranging from micro\-scale sensors to massive industrial machinery. Their core responsibility is to bridge the gap between scientific principles (like physics and math) and practical applications to solve real\-world problems. Bureau of Labor Statistics (.gov) \+3**Core Responsibilities**The day\-to\-day duties of a mechanical engineer typically follow the full product lifecycle: Workable \+1

* **Analysis \& Simulation**: Performing Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) to test stress, heat transfer, and fluid flow before physical production.
* **Prototyping \& Testing**: Developing physical prototypes (often using 3D printing or CNC machining) and conducting methodical experiments to validate performance and safety.
* **Manufacturing Oversight**: Collaborating with production teams to oversee the fabrication process, ensuring designs are manufacturable (DFM) and meet quality standards.
* **Maintenance \& Troubleshooting**: Investigating equipment failures, performing root cause analysis, and recommending design modifications to prevent future malfunctions. Workable \+9

**Required Skills \& Qualifications** Employers typically look for a mix of deep technical knowledge and "soft" collaborative skills:

* **Education**: A **Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering** is the standard entry\-level requirement. A Master's degree is often preferred for specialized R\&D roles.
* **Technical Proficiency**: Strong grasp of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, materials science, and kinematics.
* **Software Skills**: Proficiency in CAD/CAM/CAE software and mathematical computing tools like MATLAB or Excel.
* **Soft Skills**: Problem\-solving, analytical thinking, creativity, and the ability to communicate complex technical data to non\-technical stakeholders. Betterteam \+8

**Typical Work Environment**

* **Setting**: Primarily office\-based for design and analysis, with frequent visits to factories, workshops, or building sites to inspect equipment and oversee installations.
* **Collaboration**: Working in multidisciplinary teams alongside electrical engineers, project managers, software developers, and manufacturing personnel. Bureau of Labor Statistics (.gov) \+4

title: PCB Design Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a versatile **CAD Engineer** to lead the physical design and layout of our advanced controller boards. You will be responsible for the full PCB lifecycle—from footprint creation to generating manufacturing\-ready Gerber/ODB\+\+ packages. The ideal candidate is a "power user" in **Altium Designer** for complex, high\-speed projects and is equally proficient in **KiCad** for agile, open\-hardware, or rapid\-prototyping initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Dual\-Platform Layout:** Execute high\-density, multi\-layer (4–10\+ layers) PCB designs in **Altium** and **KiCad**, selecting the best tool based on project requirements.
* **High\-Speed Routing:** Implement controlled impedance, differential pairs, and length\-matching for high\-speed buses (USB 2\.0/3\.0, SPI, and memory interfaces).
* **Library Management:** Build and maintain centralized component libraries (symbols, 3D STEP models, and footprints) compliant with **IPC\-7351** standards across both platforms.
* **Signal \& Power Integrity:** Perform basic SI/PI analysis to minimize crosstalk, EMI, and power\-rail noise, especially around sensitive **RFID/NFC frontends**.
* **DFM/DFA/DFT:** Conduct thorough **Design for Manufacturing** and **Assembly** reviews to ensure high yields and lower production costs at EMS providers.
* **MCAD Collaboration:** Coordinate with mechanical engineers to ensure PCB\-to\-Enclosure fitment using **Altium 365** or **KiCad’s STEP export** features.

**Technical Skills \& Qualifications**

* **EDA Expertise:** 6 months of experience with **Altium Designer** (Unified environment, ActiveBOM) and **KiCad** (Version 7\.0/8\.0\).
* **PCB Technology:** Expertise in **HDI (High\-Density Interconnect)**, micro\-vias, and complex layer stack\-up definitions.
* **RF Awareness:** Familiarity with PCB antenna design and isolation techniques for **NXP RFID/NFC** chipsets.
* **Standards:** Strong knowledge of **IPC\-2221** (Design) and **IPC\-610** (Acceptability).
* **Version Control:** Proficiency in using **Git** for managing KiCad project files and **Altium 365** for cloud\-based versioning.

title: freelance wordpress developer
description:
1\. Position Overview

The WordPress Developer will be a part of the web development team and will assist in the design, development, customization, optimization, and maintenance of WordPress\-based websites and applications. This internship is designed to provide hands\-on, real\-world experience in WordPress development while working under the guidance of experienced developers and project managers.

The intern will gain exposure to modern web development practices, content management systems (CMS), front\-end and back\-end development concepts, website performance optimization, security best practices, and collaborative software development workflows. This role is ideal for students or recent graduates who are passionate about web technologies and eager to build a strong foundation in WordPress development.

2\. Key Objectives of the Internship

* To provide practical experience in developing and managing WordPress websites
* To help interns understand real\-world project workflows and development lifecycles
* To build technical competence in WordPress core, themes, plugins, and customization
* To develop problem\-solving, debugging, and optimization skills
* To enhance collaboration and communication skills within a professional development team

3\. Roles and Responsibilities3\.1 WordPress Development

* Assist in building, customizing, and maintaining WordPress websites based on project requirements
* Work with WordPress themes (both pre\-built and custom themes) to implement UI/UX designs
* Customize WordPress plugins and develop basic custom plugins when required
* Support the integration of third\-party tools, APIs, and plugins
* Implement responsive design principles to ensure compatibility across devices and browsers

3\.2 Front\-End Development Support

* Write clean, well\-structured HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript code
* Assist in converting design mockups (Figma, Adobe XD, PSD) into functional WordPress pages
* Optimize website layouts for performance, usability, and accessibility
* Make UI enhancements based on user feedback and testing results

3\.3 Back\-End and CMS Support

* Assist in configuring WordPress core settings, custom post types, taxonomies, and fields
* Support PHP\-based WordPress customization tasks under supervision
* Help manage databases (MySQL) related to WordPress installations
* Participate in content migration, data imports, and backups

3\.4 Website Performance and Optimization

* Assist in optimizing website speed and performance using caching, image optimization, and best practices
* Identify and resolve basic performance bottlenecks
* Support SEO\-friendly development practices such as clean URLs, schema markup, and metadata integration

3\.5 Security and Maintenance

* Assist in implementing WordPress security best practices
* Help update WordPress core, themes, and plugins while ensuring site stability
* Monitor websites for common vulnerabilities and issues
* Participate in routine maintenance tasks and quality assurance testing

3\.6 Testing and Debugging

* Conduct functional, UI, and cross\-browser testing
* Identify bugs, errors, and inconsistencies and assist in resolving them
* Use debugging tools and browser developer tools to troubleshoot issues
* Document issues clearly for senior developers

3\.7 Collaboration and Documentation

* Work closely with designers, developers, content creators, and project managers
* Participate in daily or weekly stand\-ups, sprint meetings, and project discussions
* Maintain clear documentation for development tasks, changes, and workflows
* Follow coding standards, version control practices, and internal development guidelines

4\. Required Skills and Technical Knowledge4\.1 Core Technical Skills

* Basic to intermediate understanding of WordPress CMS
* Familiarity with WordPress themes, plugins, and dashboard functionality
* Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and basic JavaScript
* Basic understanding of PHP and how it is used in WordPress
* Familiarity with MySQL databases and CMS\-driven websites

4\.2 Tools and Technologies

* WordPress (latest versions)
* Code editors such as VS Code, Sublime Text, or similar
* Version control systems (Git/GitHub or GitLab – basic knowledge preferred)
* Page builders such as Elementor, Gutenberg, or WPBakery (optional but advantageous)

4\.3 Soft Skills

* Strong willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality work
* Ability to follow instructions and meet deadlines
* Good communication skills (written and verbal)
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment

5\. Educational Qualifications

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree or diploma in:
* Computer Science
* Information Technology
* Web Development
* Software Engineering
* Or a related technical field
* Candidates from non\-technical backgrounds with demonstrable WordPress and web development skills are also encouraged to apply

6\. Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

* Prior experience with WordPress projects (academic, freelance, or personal)
* Basic knowledge of SEO concepts and digital marketing integration
* Familiarity with REST APIs and third\-party integrations
* Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG)
* Exposure to hosting environments, cPanel, or cloud hosting platforms

7\. Learning Outcomes and Growth Opportunities

By the end of the internship, the WordPress Developer Intern is expected to:

* Gain hands\-on experience in developing and managing live WordPress websites
* Understand professional development workflows and best practices
* Build a strong portfolio of WordPress\-based projects
* Improve coding, debugging, and optimization skills
* Develop confidence in working with clients, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams

High\-performing interns may be considered for:

* Internship extension
* Part\-time or full\-time WordPress Developer roles
* Advanced responsibilities on client and internal projects

8\. Performance Evaluation Criteria

Intern performance will be evaluated based on:

* Quality and accuracy of assigned development tasks
* Ability to learn and apply new concepts
* Adherence to timelines and instructions
* Communication and teamwork
* Problem\-solving and initiative

Regular feedback sessions will be conducted to support continuous improvement.

9\. Work Environment and Culture

* Collaborative and learning\-focused work environment
* Mentorship from experienced developers and technical leads
* Exposure to real\-world client projects and deadlines
* Encouragement of innovation, experimentation, and skill development
* Professional standards of conduct, confidentiality, and accountability

10\. Internship Benefits

* Hands\-on industry experience in WordPress development
* Certificate of Internship upon successful completion
* Letter of Recommendation or performance\-based referral (where applicable)
* Opportunity to work on real projects for real clients
* Flexible working hours (subject to organizational policy)
* Potential pre\-placement offer based on performance

11\. Application Process

Interested candidates should submit:

* Updated resume/CV
* Portfolio or links to WordPress projects (if available)
* A brief statement of interest explaining why they want to pursue a WordPress Developer Internship

Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete:

* A basic technical assessment
* An interview (technical and/or HR)

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time, Permanent, Fresher, Internship, Contractual / Temporary, Freelance  
Contract length: 6 months

title: Process Associate – Non-voice (freshers welcome)
description:
FreeElective Network Pvt. Ltd., based in Chennai, introduced and operates Jodi365\.com—a premium, personalized matchmaking service for elite singles.  

We understand that elite singles may be at different stages of their lives and careers, with different time frames for getting married. We work closely with discerning clients and help them find the right partner at a pace that's right for them.  

Our reach is global and we have earned much goodwill since 2009, by bringing people together. Just as important: We have a validated business model and are growing briskly.  

We are looking for a conscientious, enthusiastic, detail\-oriented individual to provide support with a variety of backend, non\-voice business processes. **ABOUT THIS JOB:**

  

The ideal Process Associate will be someone with integrity, a strong work ethic, and an eye for detail. They don't need native fluency in English, but will need to be able to converse in English, with teammates, with reasonable ease. No prior experience is necessary, either; freshers are welcome to apply!  

The work would nominally be at FreeElective Network's office in the heart of Chennai, a few miles from the IIT\-Madras campus. Most of the team has been working remotely since March 2020, and the option to work from home remains available.  

The position represents a terrific opportunity to work in a fast\-paced entrepreneurial environment, especially for someone who derives satisfaction from assisting people and playing an influential role in their making important life decisions. If you think your particular skills would add to our team, we would love to hear from you. **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

* Review submitted user profiles to ensure that they comply with our code of conduct and terms of service
* Communicate established terms, seeming violations, and required edits to users and also respond to user enquiries and complaints clearly, objectively, and patiently
* Maintain intimate knowledge of our product/service and exercise good judgment in interactions with users
* Preserve our customer base by proactively communicating with customers and promoting the value of our services
* Track user feedback and work with the customer support manager and community manager to update the online Help Center
* Work closely with the customer support manager to resolve user issues efficiently
* Ensure a consistent tone, style, and approach in responding to user enquiries and concerns, via non\-voice channels such as triggered CRM notifications, email, and live support chat
* Remain current with training, policy, and procedural updates
* Work with management team to devise processes, tools, or features to reduce tickets overall
* Assist management team in ensuring efficient progress of workflow and transforming business visions into reality

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

REQUIREMENTS:

* Genuine interest in helping our users as they go about what may be a life\-changing experience
* Good reading comprehension and at least basic communication skills (English)
* Familiarity with web technology and comfort with the Internet
* No college degree necessary; no prior work experience necessary – freshers are also invited to apply

  

PREFERENCES:

* Prior experience in any process\-related or customer\-facing job
* Fluent in at least one regional Indian language
* Ability to excel in a metrics\-driven environment
* Familiarity with customer relationship management (CRM) software tools
* Experience with consumer\-facing, interactive web sites or mobile apps

  

DESIRED SOFT SKILLS:

* Team player with strong analytical and project management skills
* Organized and detail\-oriented individual who works well with deadlines
* Willingness to learn, switch roles as necessary, and to roll up one's sleeves to get a job done
* Self\-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast\-changing environment
* Energized by the opportunities and challenges of working at a small and growing company

 **SOME TIPS, BEFORE YOU APPLY:**

  

We take this process seriously and hope that you do, too. Here are some tips, as you consider applying:* Please review our web sites – FreeElective.com, Jodi365\.com, and Peepul365\.com (in the pipeline) – before you apply, to get a good understanding of our businesses
* Be true to yourself. Ask yourself about this job, “Is this what I really want to do professionally?”
* If you don't see our full application form reproduced on this job board, go to **careers.FreeElective.com** and apply from there.
* Spare us a cut\-and\-pasted, recycled cover letter! Take the time to provide thoughtful answers to our screening questions.
* Say it in your own words. Your responses will be more compelling if they came from the heart.

  

Got any questions? Write to us at: **careers@FreeElective.com**  

Know someone who may fit the bill? Please share this job posting with them. *FreeElective is an equal\-opportunity employer and complies with applicable laws governing non\-discrimination in every location in which the company has facilities. We hire and promote individuals solely on the basis of their qualifications for the job to be filled.
