description:
**About the company:**

CognoSpace is an activity\-based educational solutions developer that prioritizes **experiential learning**. Our curriculum caters to the entire spectrum of STEAM learning purely through activities. To deliver such a curriculum we partner with schools in creating smart experiential learning labs with modern infrastructure, that includes state\-of\-the\-art Science, Math, Engineering equipment, and technology like AI, Drones, Automation, Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality, and 3D Designing/Printing.

**Who can Apply:**  
**Engineering in any Stream**  
**Interested in Robotics Trainer**   
**Freshers Welcome**

**Salary: 3\-3\.5LPA**

**About the role:**

**STEM Educator** will play a pivotal role in supporting the operations and activities of CognoSpace at the school, a physical modern **educational space** where high school students engage in **hands\-on science experiments,** and technology\-based learning using **Augmented Reality/Virtual Reality** tools. This individual will provide technical expertise, guidance, and assistance to students in delivering our curriculum, ensuring a safe and productive learning environment. He /She will be responsible for facilitating curriculum execution, and be a **liaison between the company and the school.**

**Responsibilities:**

* **Curriculum Delivery:** End\-to\-end content delivery and classroom management. Assist students in performing science experiments using CognoSpace STEM kits. Ability to use and deliver proprietary AR/VR content, AI topics, Technologies like Drones and IoT, 3D Printing
* **Managing Space:** Be the support in coordinating the entire execution process through maintenance of premises, equipment, educational tools. Collaborate with school staff and management in ensuring smooth execution of the curriculum.
* **Equipment Maintenance:** Regularly inspect, maintain, and troubleshoot lab equipment to ensure safe and optimal functionality. Coordinate repairs or replacements with the product team as needed.
* **Safety and Compliance:** Enforce safety protocols and guidelines to ensure a secure environment for students and promote responsible use of tools and equipment.
* **Resource Management:** Manage and organize the inventory of tools, supplies, and materials in the lab. Maintain accurate records of equipment usage and inventory levels.
* **Documentation and Evaluation:** Maintain comprehensive record of lesson plan execution and outcomes using CognoSpace Mobile App or the web application.
* **School Engagement:** Actively engage with student activities at schools such as parent days, sports days, science fairs, etc. to promote the CognoSpace brand by supporting stalls, workshops and the overall lab program.
* **Feedback:** Evaluate the effectiveness of lab activities and the curriculum. Provide feedback to the CognoSpace product development team and propose improvements.
* **Training (Future proposition):** Take on the role of a trainer to mentor and train new lab specialists, providing guidance on effective support techniques, technical knowledge, best practices and safety protocols.

**Qualifications Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering
* Prior teaching experience is a plus.
* Experience working in a collaborative environment like laboratories/tinker\-labs/STEM labs/Computer labs lab, laboratory, or science\-related environment is a plus.
* Freshers are encouraged if they come with an Engineering Background
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with students, teachers, parents, and school management.
* Experience in Robotics labs, Makerspace will be a plus.
* Leverage company mobile APP and digital content for end\-to\-end delivery and classroom management.
* Assist students in performing activities using CognoSpace STEM kits, Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality \& 3D Printing.
* The Initial salary pay range will be from 3 LPA .

**Training:**

**2\-3 weeks of training will be offered upon joining and before deployment in schools.**

 .

 **60 to 100** 
**people** 
 within a year, doing everything we can to help people reach their potential.

* Regular

 with the team to understand how they’re doing personally \& professionally, enabling them to become successful by teaming up with peers \& managers.

* You like the challenge of taking BiteSpeed from total chaos to less chaos as we scale from
 **to 100\+ employees** 
 , with smart processes \& diligent execution.



  




* You have
 **2\+ years of experience** 
 driving the people function at an early stage startup (50\+ employees).



  




* You’re a

 All work and no play makes jack a dull boy. Cult Fit and Cult Play passes to make sure we hit the gym more often.



  




* **Personal Development \-** 
 We sponsor courses, conference tickets, books on a case to case basis to ensure we’re constantly growing.

 Trust first, by default. We pay out salaries in the first week of the month.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 




 Arboreal is an award\-winning ingredients technology company focused on specialty food \& nutraceutical ingredients. We manufacture highly differentiated ingredient systems and solutions to give challenger brands a competitive edge in the market. With expertise in Sugar Reduction Ingredients, Cacao Solutions, Proteins, and Nutraceutical Ingredients, we collaborate closely with brands to launch category\-defining products and help them scale.
 



 Arboreal is co\-founded by Swati Pandey (IIT, Imperial College London) and Manish Chauhan (BITS Pilani, London Business School).
 **Arboreal has won the 'National Startup Award'** 
 for Food Processing in 2021 (adjudged by Startup India),
 **CWIA Award** 
 (adjudged by McKinsey, INSEAD Business School and Cartier),
 **WTI Award** 
 (from Niti Ayog) and the
 **BIG Award** 
 (BIRAC Ignition Grant from Department of Biotechnology, India).
 



  





**Role Description** 




**Arboreal is looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Human Resource Specialist (TA \& Operations)** 
 to join the Human Resources department. We are growing fast—not just in headcount, but in complexity. We need an HR Specialist who is 60% "Hunter" (finding the rare talent that fits our high\-bar culture) and 40% "Architect" (building the operational systems that keep our team running smoothly).
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**🚀 Talent Acquisition (60%)** 



* **Full\-Cycle Ownership:** 
 Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment funnel for roles across departments.
* **Sourcing Strategy:** 
 Go beyond LinkedIn InMails. Use niche communities, and your own network to find "passive" gems.
* **Candidate Experience:** 
 Ensure every candidate feels like a VIP, regardless of the outcome. You are the face of our brand.
* **Hiring Manager Partnership:** 
 Help leads define what they
 *actually* 
 need.



**⚙️ People Operations (40%)** 



* **Seamless Onboarding:** 
 Turn "Day 1" into an unforgettable experience that sets new hires up for immediate success.
* **Compliance \& Documentation:** 
 Own the HRIS, employee files, and compliance—ensuring we are audit\-ready and legally sound.
* **Policy Evolution:** 
 Help us iterate on leave policies, handbook updates, and benefits as we scale.
* **Employee Engagement:** 
 Support internal initiatives that keep our high\-performance culture healthy and connected.



  





**Qualifications** 



* **MBA in Human Resources** 
 with at least
 **2 years’ experience** 
 in a high\-growth, high\-pressure environment (FMCG or Deep Science). You don't panic when priorities shift.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* You can pivot from a
 **high\-level headhunting call** 
 to a detailed payroll sheet.
* You understand that "Resources" are people. You lead with empathy but stay grounded in business goals.
* High level of integrity, confidentiality, and professionalism.
* Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast\-paced environment.
* A positive attitude and eagerness to learn.



  





**What we offer:** 



* **Competitive Compensation.** 
 A full\-time offer will carry a salary range of 5 – 9 LPA. Performance Linked Compensation to start with. We do not follow the industry norms of linear growth in compensation. We are a fast\-scaling business and offer excellent financial growth to top performers.
* **Fast track personal and professional growth.** 
 You will work directly with the Founders and a high\-quality team. Learning experience of joining and scaling a high\-quality startup at an early stage.



  





**Please do not apply if you are not willing to relocate to Lucknow or are not already based in Lucknow.**

description:
**Company Profile** 






 Bain \& Company is the management consulting firm that the world’s business leaders come to when they want results. Bain advises clients on strategy, operations, information technology, organization, private equity, digital transformation and strategy, and mergers and acquisition, developing practical insights that clients act on and transferring skills that make change stick. The firm aligns its incentives with clients by linking its fees to their results. Bain clients have outperformed the stock market 4 to 1\. Founded in 1973, Bain has offices in various countries, and its deep expertise and client roster cross every industry and economic sector.
 







 The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS).
 



 Global Business Services (GBS)
 



 is a network of five interconnected business\-function hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally.  Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
 










  






**What Makes Us a Best Place to Work** 








 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times.
   

  Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
 








  




**Job Summary** 









  




**PAYROLL** 


 :
 



* Should have enough understanding \& logical thinking behind every concept of payroll terms, its application in payroll system \& implication on different destination.
* Expatriate taxation, working with gross ups \& dealing with monthly \& yearly international reporting.
* End to End Payroll processing until finalization of payroll independently.
* Execute multiple micro processes post finalization of salary until the delivery of payroll.
* Should have well versed with reporting of different reports to different stakeholders in the company.
* Should be pro\-active and able to think multiple solution scenarios of a problem simultaneously.
* Should be confident enough to face the customers, the problems and get solutions in a quick way.
* Should aware end to end Form\-16 PartA \& B reconciliation before issuing to employees.
* Should maintain TDS \& other payroll related trackers on perquisites paid by the employer \& compliances.
* Should have good knowledge of excel to prepare end to end bonus calculation for all consulting \& local business function employees.
* Professional customer service attitude.
* Capability of dealing with banks \& external various vendors.




  
 





**COMPLIANCES:** 




* Should have Knowledge \& good understanding on statutory \& Labour compliances.
* Should be well versed with preparing data for filing up of TDS returns, PF returns, Professional tax returns, Labour welfare funds \& its implication upon filing to respective domains.
* Dealing with different compliance vendors to get all the compliances in place every month.
* Arrangement of various helpdesk in office premises.







  




**ACCOUNTING /AUDITS:** 




* Should know monthly payroll journal entries booking \& other works related to accounting leading to month end close. This will be an added advantage.
* Should have capabilities to clear all payroll related reconciliations.
* Should work with internal auditors, statutory auditors \& tax auditors to help in audits.







  




**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** 




* Graduate with 6 \+ years of experience in payroll, accounting \& compliances department.


* Ability of multi\-tasking under pressure whilst maintain calm, professional \& customer focused attitude.


* High level of integrity, accountability \& responsibility.
* Deal with huge numbers \& maintain confidentiality.
* Strong people\-oriented and good interpersonal skills
* Sharp problem solver \& analytical mind bend.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* High energy, with a positive work attitude


* Pro\-active approach towards work and learning.
* Flexible approach to working hours.
* Professional customer service attitude.
* Focused \& detail oriented.

description:
We're the global leader in providing energy solutions that help businesses grow and communities thrive. We work as a team and we’re proud of the difference we make to customers, to local communities, and towards a sustainable future for the world.
   

  

 We’re looking for a
 **People Services Advisor** 
 to join our global team. The People Services Advisor supports the day\-to\-day queries that are raised with the regional People Services team as well as providing support and guidance to line managers on foundation cases, helping to develop the managers’ capability and skills to manage and resolve people queries and issues themselves.
   

  

**Why Aggreko?**
* Full time role to be based in Pune, India
* Competitive compensation package
* Industry\-leading benefit plans
* Continuous training and development with career growth opportunities
* Safety\-focused culture


**What You’ll Do**
* Deliver timely and accurate People Administration services across the Middle East and India region.
* Provide precise support in coordinating all employee lifecycle transactions, ensuring consistency, compliance with local HR legislation, and adherence to regulatory requirements. This includes reviewing and updating all documentation—such as employment contracts and pre‑employment screening materials—in line with legislative changes.
* Own the delivery of high‑quality, professional customer service by resolving day‑to‑day enquiries, issues, and complaints from employees and managers.
* Respond promptly to Workday Help cases, escalating complex matters to subject\-matter specialists or the People Services Manager when appropriate.
* Proactively coach managers and employees to confidently use Workday, follow established processes and best practices, and apply relevant policies and guidance materials.
* Support accurate management of people data within HR systems, including onboarding, offboarding, bulk data uploads, system updates, position management, and maintaining strong data quality standards.
* Ensure all payroll\-related data is prepared, validated, and submitted accurately and on time in accordance with payroll cut\-off timelines.
* Generate reports, metrics, and data insights to support People Team processes, decision‑making, and key events.


**You’ll Have The Following Skills And Experience**
* Proven HR generalist knowledge with global/cultural awareness.
* Track record of applying legal and regulatory HR frameworks.
* Experience in an operational/shared service environment.
* Highly organized, diligent, and able to manage workload to meet SLAs under pressure.
* Strong IT proficiency, confident communication (verbal \& written).
* Fluent English essential; business fluency in another language is a plus.
* Proficiency with HR technology solutions, preferably Workday, and data management.


 Find out more and apply now.
   

  

**Bring your energy. Grow your career.**
**Equal employment opportunity**
 We welcome people from different backgrounds and cultures, and respect people’s unique skills, attitudes and experiences. We encourage everyone to be themselves at work because we know that’s how we do our best, for each other, for our customers, for the communities where we work, and for our careers.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer. If you apply for a role at Aggreko, we will consider your application based on your qualifications and experience, and not on your race, colour, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.
